Tang Chanh Hue

THE CAUSE OF CAUSE BETWEEN ME AND Bodhisattva

This happened at the end of 2003, at that time I worked as a tour guide at Sanya company in Hainan.

Every day I am in charge of driving to pick up passengers and take them to visit the island or scenic spots. At that time, I really liked to chant the "Great Compassion Mantra". Every time I drove, I would play the disc and chant the Great Compassion Mantra. Tourists also enjoyed listening to it, especially the elderly, who loved it even more.

Every day I listen to it without getting bored. For me, I don't need to memorize anything, I listen to it until it's smooth, and often recite it with my mouth. This is probably a good root for many lifetimes.

One time, I went to visit the ancient town of Phoenix in Hunan and stayed here for three days, then prepared to go to the airport to fly home.

That morning, the weather was not good, it was pouring rain. I was busy renting a car, the driver asked for 350 VND, then we went to the airport together.

Everyone in Hunan knows that although the scenery here has beautiful mountains, if there is heavy rain, it will create obstacles and disasters for travelers. That means driving in the rain is extremely dangerous. (Because the mud and rocks flowing down from the mountains will cause landslides or block roads, not only blocking traffic but also causing people to lose their cars).

I'm a guest from far away so I'm not familiar with anything here. Once I get in the car, I sit and close my eyes, constantly chanting "Great Compassion Mantra". I really like chanting mantras, without any purpose, nor to pray for anything, just chanting out of habit, whenever I have free time I just chant. I also don't know if chanting the mantra will bring me any good things? In short, with a joyful mind, I kept chanting the "Great Compassion Mantra" continuously. It can also be said that perhaps "Uncle Great Compassion" gives me a feeling of peace and joy, that's all.

From Phuong Hoang old town to the airport it takes three hours. When the bus left Phuong Hoang for 40 minutes, something happened. Because the sand and soil on the mountain was hit by heavy rain, creating a strong flow, causing rocks and soil to fall, and aimed directly at our car, causing the front and back of the car to be dented and crushed: The car's glass was broken and the car was seriously damaged, but luckily the driver and I were safe. At that time, I had absolutely no fear in my heart and thought to myself: "Today I am very lucky, I encountered a great and dangerous accident and escaped without losing my life"...

A few years later, thanks to studying Buddha's teachings, I clearly understood: It turned out that it was not my luck that I was able to escape death when I encountered a great tribulation, but it was thanks to Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara's silent blessing. He knew that I was in this tribulation and saved our lives. Because in the "Great Compassion Mantra" it was said:

“Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara made great vows to save sentient beings, then He ascended from the First Ground to the Ten Grounds (thousand eyes and thousand hands are a manifestation of Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara's great compassion). Wherever he saw sentient beings suffering, he went there to help."

In the sutra it says: “If anyone sincerely chants the Great Compassion Mantra, they will always be blessed by Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara”… This is a thousand truths, absolutely should not be doubted. Perhaps you don't believe it and think it's a coincidence that I am at peace? Then I would like to tell another story, to prove that Bodhisattva is "looking" at me.

It just happened recently. My daughter took the high school entrance exam. Although her academic performance was average, she was very studious and determined. He always wished and wished to take the entrance exam to a famous school in the city center. Because: "If you are kind and virtuous, even the birds of the wild and phoenixes will fly far away"...If you encounter a good environment, your learning and virtue will be sublimated.

Before taking the exam, my daughter asked her homeroom professor to present her wishes and fill in the name of the school she wanted to enter: “Shanghai Specialized High School” (this is a famous school, admission standards are very high, it is very difficult to get in)… The professor just looked at it and his eyes widened in surprise. He looked at it from head to toe and said:

– You must be crazy! You wouldn't be able to get into this school with a normal academic record like yours!

Therefore, he flatly refused.

But my daughter did not give up. She entered another school, also in the city center, but the admission standards were extremely strict and more difficult than the previous school... This school has an extremely superior learning environment, full of good professors, very high moral character, and many famous people have come from this school. Many famous families also send their children to this school.

The homeroom professor saw him write like that (he thought his "crazy" disease was incurable) and said:

- Okay, I'll give you your satisfaction! Anyway, I dare say that you won't be able to take the exam here! But okay, just let me daydream a little! Even if I try my best, I'll listen!

My child came home very unhappy, he cried angrily and told me:

– Dad, the homeroom professor despised me, he laughed at me when he saw me enroll in that school, but really I tried, I strived tirelessly, huh huh...

I patted and comforted it:

– Dear daughter, the ancients often said: “If there is a will, there is a way”… If you have high ambitions, study hard and diligently, and you will definitely get your wish. This is called “Heaven's Way compensates for the hearted person!”… Dad promises to support you because you have done many good deeds and accumulated positive virtues to dedicating merit and blessings to you!

During her exam, I kept my promise. Usually every day at two o'clock in the morning I wake up and recite Buddhist scriptures, but these days I have to respectfully recite the "Vajra Sutra" for her, vowing to dedicate this merit specifically to her. Because the "Vajra Sutra" opens great wisdom, I hope my daughter will eliminate negative karma, increase blessings, and receive Buddha's blessing...

During the evening recitation session, I sincerely recited the "Great Compassion Mantra" with one mind and one mind, asking Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara to bless her, making her wish come true.

A week before the exam results came out, I dreamed that Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva gave me a dream, saying my child got 597 points.

In the morning, I immediately announced this good news to my wife and children. No one of them believed it. My daughter also said:

This time I don't dare to think about whether I passed the exam or not, because I didn't do very well in literature. Maybe this dream is "contrary" to reality, dad!

Seven days later, my son went online to check his exam results, he was extremely scared, his heart was beating like a war drum (you can use the phrase "brave the heart sutra" to describe the nervousness like going to the execution ground to imagine)... But it was clear on the computer screen that the score appeared very high: Literature subject has more than 15 points left over. I said:

– Quickly take out the spreadsheet and add it all up and try again?

After a while of adding up, it was exactly the same 597 points, neither too much nor too little.

I hastily reminded:

– Do you remember last week when I informed you of the results like this? Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara told me in a dream that I passed the exam and got 597 points!

At this moment, mother and daughter were both stunned for a moment, then extremely happy, the whole family was so happy that nothing could describe it, because the child's wish to enter a high-class school in the city center had been achieved. My daughter was so happy that she couldn't speak, she kept stammering:

– Ba… Dad!…

I said:

– Come quickly and pay homage to Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara!

Our whole family quickly went to burn incense and worship, I bowed to Him a hundred times, expressing my utmost gratitude.

Personally, I chant Buddha for 15 hours every day. In the evening, I read the making vows of the "Great Compassion Mantra", then recite the "Great Compassion Mantra" 5 times and then recite Amitabha Buddha! Next is Reciting Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva!…

There is no luck in this world that is without reason. When people encounter important times, if they don't rely on their blessings and blessings, they can only rely on noble people to support them...

I am an ordinary person with many sins, karma is deep and heavy, blessings are thin and silver, if Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara had not saved me, my life would have passed away long ago, drifting in evil paths and suffering... Obviously, it can be seen that my noble person is Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara! This also truly proves the immeasurable might and majesty of "a thousand lands seek, a thousand lands respond; Bodhisattva's magnetic boat to save all sentient beings in the sea of suffering!

I share my real experience, hoping that Dharma friends will increase their trust in Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara. When encountering an important or dangerous moment, sincerely pray for His blessings. We must believe deeply without doubt, wholeheartedly chant His name to eliminate distracting thoughts, help our mind become calm and peaceful, and should not have crazy distracting thoughts.

In the Great Compassion Sutra, it is said: If the person making vows chants about 5 times of the "Great Compassion Mantra" every day, it can help eliminate hundreds of thousands of memories of serious birth and death sins. When they die, they can freely rebirth, and can even go to the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss World. If this vow is not fulfilled, he will never become a Buddha. If a person making vows recites the "Great Compassion Mantra" about 5 times a day, and falls into the three evil realms at the time of death, he will never become a Buddha.

(Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara actually soon became a Buddha, his name is Dharma Insight Tathagata, His words are completely true, no lies).

tom_tat: Translator's words: This article is truly touching, filled with Buddha's compassion for sentient beings and fatherly love
noi_dung:
Layman Lam Long Dat

Translator's words: This article is truly touching, filled with Buddha's compassion for sentient beings and a father's love for his children.

If you want to say Buddha compassion, why wait for sentient beings to call and chant his name to save? Just like the sun and moon radiate light for all, but whoever wants to receive it must open the door. If you keep the door closed tightly, light cannot penetrate.

Radio and television stations… Every channel shows and broadcasts it for us to watch, but we have to turn it on to the right frequency to watch it. Similarly, if you want to communicate with all Buddhas Bodhisattva, you must recite the name. During that time, your mind will stop being chaotic and your mind will be pure. Only then will it be easy to connect sympathetically with all Buddhas. That is the reason why we must chant His name.

And the father here is a typical Buddha disciple. Normally, if people do not know the religion, they often run after material things, talent, and beauty... and pay little attention to children and family. But the father here, in addition to self-cultivation, also cares and loves his children very much. When you take the exam, I make vows to practice good deeds, create blessings, and accumulate negative virtue to determine merit for you.

Therefore, when one becomes a disciple of Buddha, even though one has not yet left the home life, one's life is still very happy, because thanks to the determination to keep the precepts, the husband and wife behave faithfully, the family is peaceful and harmonious, the life is filled with love... Because they do not create evil and have pure goodness in their hearts, they enjoy happiness right in this life. This is the benefit of Buddhist families.

SIX STORIES cause and effect

Recently, a man named Truong, living in Ho Khau village, Tan Truc district, wrote a letter to tell many cause and effect stories that he personally witnessed or heard. He insisted that these stories were completely true: As a real person, with real deeds, with constant evidence, please announce it so that the world can be alert. Hopefully through this, everyone will learn many good things and believe more deeply in cause and effect "Do not do evil things, do good things" thanks to which social morale is improved.

Now let me tell each story in the following order:

tom_tat: Before I learned about Buddha's teachings, I was very cruel, had no compassion towards animals, did not know pity or sympathy.
noi_dung:
1. My evil retribution

Before I learned about Buddha's teachings, I was very cruel, had no compassion towards animals, did not know any mercy or sympathy.

More than 20 years ago, my whole family worked at a shoe factory, and there was teacher X (who taught engineering) who loved to eat dog meat. One time, Mr.

Also, if I happen to encounter a snake, I think of all sorts of ways to catch it, then use a rock to smash the snake's head. Before dying, the snake constantly struggles and writhes in pain. I just calmly look on as if I didn't see anything, with no pity in my heart, no remorse for my inhumane and cruel actions.

After that, I continuously suffered from many suffering diseases: 7 years ago, I was working at a road construction crew where a construction vehicle suddenly backed away. I was caught off guard and suffered a brain injury. I had to be hospitalized for treatment. It took me a long time to recover.

After that, my stomach pain broke out. I went to many large and small hospitals for treatment and took all kinds of Eastern and Western medicine, but to no avail.

In the end, I reluctantly had to apply according to some folk prescriptions, because this remedy requires the meat of many types of living beings (such as dogs, cats, snakes, turtles, centipedes, chickens, ducks, etc.) to be combined with steaming, cooking, stewing, grilling... just takes effect. As a result, I killed many more lives... But after taking all kinds of medicine for a long time, my illness not only did not improve but also got worse.

After that, I went to major hospitals for examination. The doctor said that if I didn't operate immediately, it would be difficult to save my life, so I had to have surgery. More than two-thirds of my stomach was removed, and a piece of my intestines was also removed, showing that the situation at that time was extremely serious.

Last year, when I was working at a factory, I accidentally hit a machine and injured my finger, causing it to bleed non-stop, with heart-wrenching pain. I screamed miserably and almost fainted. When I saw my broken, bleeding hand and my fingers shaking uncontrollably, I suddenly remembered how in the past I used to beat snakes and kill dogs... Blood stained the yard red. That's when I started asking myself: "For the past ten years, I have been constantly tormented by evil diseases and have had many accidents and injuries. Is this all retribution for killing in the past?"...

2. Old man Tran

I have a female karma medium named Tran. During the meeting, this young lady said that her father, Mr. Tran, has a special hobby: Very fond of eating fish eyes. Every time he had a meal, if there was fish on the table, he would always gouge out its eyes and eat it, praising it that it was delicious. He also told his family to buy a lot of fish, especially if the fish had to be alive, so they would enjoy eating it.

Later, her father suddenly got an eye infection. The disease broke out and became so serious that many famous doctors were unable to cure it. After that, her father's eye was completely blind. The doctor took it out and replaced it with a prosthetic eyeball.

The following year, her father's remaining eye also got sick, and he soon lost his sight. Now he has to live through a series of days without seeing light.

3. The evil retribution of the Tran brothers

I have a classmate named Tran, he is a soldier, every time he comes home from leave, he and his younger brother often go fishing, go to the mountains to catch animals or shoot birds... consider this a hobby.

Later on, his house continuously encountered mishaps. The first was his younger brother. During construction, he accidentally fell from the scaffolding on the second floor. Because it was a construction site, iron and steel were lying haphazardly underneath. His younger brother was punctured in the abdomen by an iron, seriously injuring his intestines, and shortly after he died. Next is Mr. Tran himself, suffering from a terrible illness, suffering excruciating pain... And yet, just because of a little chore, he argued with his wife so fiercely that they had to divorce. A family that was once happy and fulfilled is now separated, making people sigh.

4. Gunner buddy

At my work place, there is a karma coin that is very fond of using slings to shoot birds. The gunner's talent is extremely accurate, almost hitting 100 times. Every time he shoots, he hits a dangerous spot, injuring the bird's head. If you take action, no one will escape...

Over the past few years, everyone has admired his talent and has not spared words of admiration and praise.

Last year, while my unit was repairing a construction project, the crane on the truck suddenly broke and fell from above, hitting an employee below in the head. The heavy impact of the iron hook caused the victim's head to be crushed (like a watermelon being split open), brains splattered everywhere, and blood flowed all over the ground. Everyone who witnessed it was shocked and did not dare to look. It turned out that the victim was the karma fellow who had a talent for shooting.

5. When unjustly reported

I have an elder who loves to eat meat, especially pork trotters, wings and chicken feet. Not only did he eat three consecutive meals a day, but every time he enjoyed dinner with five or three drinking partners, he always had the above dishes. It can be said that he loved eating meat extremely and never got bored.

When he was old, this elder had too much Uric Acid, so his limbs were deformed and bent, and there were many scary ulcers on his face. Some places on the skin also developed rot. Even though he went everywhere to seek treatment, he could not cure it. One time he accidentally fell and broke his femur. He groaned in pain for several days and then passed away. According to family members, a few days before his death, he often trembled and screamed in panic:

– “Someone is coming to take me away! Someone wants to take me away! They want to be friends with me”… makes anyone who hears it go crazy.

tom_tat: In my hometown, the elders often tell us young people a story to show off
noi_dung:
6. Be careful when swearing

In my hometown, the elders often tell us young people a story to warn them:

Thirty years ago, Taiwan had a number of poor people who made a living by selling goods. One time, a cloth seller brought goods to the village and the women gathered to watch. They took the fabric and passed it around to each other, looking at it and taking turns commenting, but no one bought it. The seller saw that and took the fabric back, but when he checked the goods, he discovered that a bunch of fabric was missing. At this point, everyone said they didn't have it. Among the group of women, there was a woman who not only aggressively asserted that she would not marry, but also swore to herself as follows:

– If I took the cloth like you guys said, I would get hit by a car and die!

Then she went to Kinmen. One day, while she was sitting at home, a truck's brakes broke, crashed straight into the house, and killed her.

When this news spread, everyone was talking loudly, thinking that this was an extremely scary cause and effect of retribution.

SPECIALISTS OF FORENSIC POLICE

I am a judicial medical police officer, people often call it a forensic scientist. I provide medical assessment documents for two Courts and four Judicial Police branches. To put it simply, if a murder occurs somewhere, bring the body to us so we can examine it, find the cause of death, then write down a full report and hand it over to the Court or the Police Department.

People are born and must die, but the causes of death come in all shapes and sizes, it's hard to imagine...

When we make a report, we act very seriously and thoroughly. Must analyze cause of death, direct cause of death, secondary causes, summary of cause of death...

The reason I explain a lot about technical terms is to say that our society always has a correct and legal explanation for death.

For example, there was an old man over 70 years old who was hit by a tram, hit his head on a cement pole on the side of the road and died. Inspection revealed damage to the head and broken skull leading to death. Here, the injured head is the primary nucleus, the affected skull is the direct nucleus, and the immune system disorder is the secondary nucleus.

But does such an explanation really provide a sufficient answer to the important question "why do people die"?... I worked at the Institute of Forensic Medicine for 26 years and always felt confused and confused about this phenomenon. Because of the same injuries, some people die and some people live?! That means there are people with very light injuries who die, and people with serious injuries that make everyone think their lives are over, but have a miracle of survival...

Later, when I came into contact with Buddha's teachings and gained some understanding of the religion, I could understand all of these issues.

Death is a part of this world, the end of life. If we look from this perspective, we can clearly understand the truth of death.

In recent years, I have often carefully researched and recorded meticulously the cases I have handled. The more we learn, the clearer it becomes that death does not arise by chance, but it eloquently proves cause and effect.

I often meet relatives of the dead, looking at me in pain and crying:

– Why did he, so kind, leave this life so early? Why did that man do so many evil deeds and live a long life? Why does a person who has been careful all his life often encounter misfortunes? Why are pedestrians so careless that even if they are hit by a car, they are not harmed?

I think, the reason for these complaints is: Because they don't make cause and effect transparent.

First of all, I would like to tell you about the case that made me feel miserable and worried... It was this case that pushed me to Buddhism. Although the case is not complicated, due to the long investigation time, I am relatively absorbed:

tom_tat: In 2002, a 28-year-old man killed his two sixty-year-old parents in the middle of the night. This old couple was sleeping when their son tied them to the bed, then he cut their throats, blood splattered...
noi_dung:
1. The couple died tragically

In 2002, a 28-year-old man killed his two sixty-year-old parents in the middle of the night. This old couple was sleeping when their son tied them to the bed, then he cut their throats, blood splattered on the wall and fell everywhere... The perpetrator ran away that night, then was arrested in a small neighborhood in the south.

The perpetrator was married and had a son. On the night of the murder, the wife, due to an argument that broke out the day before, angrily took the child to her parents' house, thus avoiding the nightmare of a massacre.

On the surface, this is a clear case, with extremely accurate evidence, the Procuracy has taken oral confessions, all evidence is complete, there are enough exhibits and witnesses, of course it must be strictly punished and quickly reach a verdict.

At the first trial, the death penalty was immediately imposed, but the defense lawyer said: “The prisoner has a serious mental illness” and requested a neurological examination for later trial.

The investigation time is long, because the results are unclear, so the case continues to drag on... In the end, the death sentence had to be postponed to be served two years later. The perpetrator's lawyer filed another complaint, but it was rejected. It seemed like the verdict was over and the case was over.

It sounds so quick, but in reality, this case lasted a total of four years. I had to work hard to investigate meticulously, collect evidence 7-8 times, and the accumulated documents were thick.

The perpetrator is the only son in the family, has been pampered since childhood, and has an extremely fierce personality. After the perpetrator got married, he still lived with his parents and often caused arguments. A few days before the crime, a conflict broke out between the perpetrator's parents and his wife. Afterwards, the perpetrator asked his parents for money to buy a house, but the parents said they had no money for the time being and blamed their son for being incompetent and useless, not caring about work, causing them to lose face with their neighbors!... This evoked evil thoughts of murder in the perpetrator.

However, is this enough to explain the killer's motive for murder? In this world, how many children are pampered, become disobedient, and have disputes with their families? Why did the murderer insist on killing his parents?

In the file, I discovered an extremely shocking confession, the perpetrator honestly declared as follows:

– “I wanted to kill them a long time ago, because they are so useless! Tell me to buy a house but they still won't, then kill me! For what?… I drafted a plan a few months ago (because they are parents, I don't want them to die too painfully). First I thought I should give them… I took hopper medicine, but I was only halfway there. Before I got to the store, I turned back, because I thought the hopper medicine would burn my intestines. Then I planned to take them to the lake to play, then drown them. But I didn't do it. Finally thinking about it, I found there was only one way... Cutting the throat is the best, not too painful, and quick to die"...

When I finished reading this oral passage, I was scared to the core. Killing his parents he expressed calmly as if he killed... chickens and ducks! After meticulous investigation, I was even more shocked when I discovered this additional detail:

The victim couple opened a chicken slaughterhouse and did very well in the market. When I went to the market to investigate, because the chicken shop owner was killed, people thought that this store was unlucky and had bad business, so everyone left without even wanting to rent. According to people nearby, when the victim and his wife practiced their profession, they often tied up live chickens, hung them on steel wire, then clamped the chicken's head tightly and used a knife to cut its throat. Chicken blood is not wasted, it can be sold for a lot of money. Throughout their lives, they lived on this job and became rich. It is said that the technique of cutting chicken necks was passed down by their ancestors.

The reason I remember this clearly is because this is the case that made me start to have faith in religion. When every analysis has a reasonable explanation, I believe more deeply in the law of cause and effect and take to heart the understanding of the cause… That night I didn't sleep almost all night. Because the deceased practiced cutting chicken throats all his life, he was famous for his skillful killing... Because they cut ancient objects like that, they had the accident of having their only son cut his throat again... Doesn't this retribution make us heartbroken?

Translator's words:

Translating here, I suddenly remember the story told by a Dharma traveler from Hanoi: Near her house, there is a couple who make a living by slaughtering pigs and selling meat, and their economy is very good. They have an only son, about 15 years old, with a very gentle personality.

One day when the boy came home from school, he suddenly killed his parents and chopped up their flesh and threw them everywhere on the floor. Then he went upstairs to sleep.

When the police came to arrest him, the boy was still sleepy. Everyone was horrified by this massacre and could not explain the reason.

Please let me ponder. Now please watch another story of the Forensic police officer:

tieu_de: 2. The tragic ending of director Trieu
tom_tat: We often think that death is bad and scary, but in some cases "not being allowed to die" is even more miserable and painful, a more severe punishment than death.
noi_dung:
2. The tragic ending of director Trieu

We often think that death is bad and scary, but in some cases "not being allowed to die" is even more miserable and painful, a more severe punishment than death!

This is a difficult problem that arose at a mining company, whose owner is Mr. Trieu, the founder of the "Coal Mining Company" in a certain small town.

The company does not have any labor safety insurance, all business is maintained by private individuals who have close connections with powerful figures. Of course, Mr. Trieu has a very strong umbrella, so after the accident at the mine, it was difficult for the locality to investigate smoothly, so they had to let us handle the case in this remote area.

The coal mine exploded and caused toxic fumes, killing one person and injuring two others. Normally, accidents that occur are settled according to "hidden rules", as long as the owner skillfully pays compensation for the worker's property, it can be overlooked.

But unfortunately, right at that time, a nationwide inspection was ordered, forcing strict enforcement, so the company owner was arrested.

When I and another scout went to look for Mr. Trieu to get evidence, the guard told me:

– Mr. Trieu has diabetes so he was taken to the hospital.

I quickly ran to the "Ministry of Justice Hospital" to see Mr. Trieu. Seeing that he was about 50 years old, with a handsome figure, a loud voice, a very strong personality, it seemed like he was not easy to cooperate with.

He sat on the bed, seemed indifferent to the issues I raised, had a cold attitude of not caring, until when I was about to leave, he bluntly declared:

– In less than a month, someone sponsored me out of here!

He said it was not wrong, because the investigation team was hindered by many reasons, so the work did not proceed smoothly. In the end, the case was resolved by releasing him on bail, only monitoring his residence. But on the very night he was happy and excited to immediately restore his free identity, his diabetes and gallstones suddenly developed seriously. Even though the Ministry of Justice and the Hospital had no intention of keeping him, it was the illness that held him back and forced him to stay.

From then on, Mr. Trieu could no longer leave the hospital. After more than 4 months, this case was finally decided: Mr. Trieu was sentenced to 6 years in prison. But he could not be released from prison, because his health was deteriorating day by day, so his punishment could only be carried out at the "Police Hospital".

For work reasons, I always have to go to the "Police Hospital" for karma, so I often meet Mr. Trieu. Thanks to his money, he was still able to live in a clean single room, but the window was covered with iron railings. Every time we met, his eyes opened very wide as if filled with many thoughts. One time he asked me:

-Do you believe in cause and effect?

I replied:

– Of course there is! Because I am a follower of Buddhism.

He suddenly sighed and said nothing more.

After a while, his illness got worse and he had to be transferred to the hospital. The warden took care of the procedures to let him out. Very strangely, not only did the prison guards and the Hospital not want to keep him, but even the King of Hell criticized him and refused to accept him!

When I met him again, he had been in bed for nearly eight months. He was one meter eight meters tall but his weight had quickly lost weight. We often met and talked, and he trusted me more and more... Sometimes, he even asked me to do some things.

Although I come from a medical background, I have never seen anyone as skinny as him. The eyes were sunken deep into their sockets, the cheekbones were bulging, the lips were pale, the ribs were protruding, each one clearly visible.

When he breathed, the bones rose and fell, looking like they would break with just a slight impact. His legs and arms made people even more afraid to look at them. They were so thin and had no flesh left. Because the bile had formed, he had to have surgery. (Because of his diabetes, the wound continued to heal and was infected and the ulcers spread around). Looking at his shape, he looked like a skull attached to a skeleton, enough to scare people... I still have nightmares when I sleep at night!

I investigated the course of his illness and found that according to common sense, sick people like him (whose vital organs were exhausted and whose heart no longer had the strength to maintain a pulse) had difficulty living, yet he continued to live long in agony, suffering extreme pain but still did not die. Even though he often expressed it to me, right now he only wishes for one thing... be dead! If he could die, he would be very happy. But this “reward” from “heaven” was also stingy and not given to him generously! Let him live but every second and every minute will be tormented and extremely painful.

One time he wanted to die so much, he stopped eating and drinking, fasted for more than ten days, his body and mind were in extreme decline, the doctor thought he must definitely die! But he still lives, he can't die!

After being gone for a long time, I was busy with work so I didn't come to see him. So one day he asked the nurse to call and invite me to come.

That night, he gathered all his strength and told me his secret story in a weak voice...

“More than ten years ago, when he just started mining ore, because he didn't have enough money, he had to ask someone to go to the train station, brush aside foolish vagrants who didn't know the law, and hire them to go down to the underground to work for him.

Thanks to that, he doesn't have to pay any salary, just hire a few security guards to watch over these workers. When they had accumulated the first barrel of gold for him, in order to hide the truth, he had that coal well filled up, leaving the workers locked up, tired, hungry, and thirsty in the dark, and in the end they all suffocated!”…

(What he told was later confirmed, when the police went to that place to exhume and brought up twenty or so skeletons).

Next, Mr. Trieu stayed at the hospital for nearly half a year. During these six months, he experienced extreme danger almost every minute and every second. But no matter how much pain his body was tortured and tormented, he still did not die. His entire fortune was spent on hospital fees, and his family eventually stopped coming to visit him. Despite the extreme danger, day and night he groaned in pain continuously, his voice was heartbreaking. Due to a serious lack of immunity, wounds on the body do not heal anywhere, they are all infected, ulcerated and rotting.

In the end, he could no longer find a healthy part of his body, his whole body was covered in ulcers.

After that, I never saw him again. I heard from the nurses who took care of him that after he died, when they used a sheet to wrap his body to move him, his bones were broken, his flesh was rotten and pus filled, turning into a pile of mucus. Before putting his body in the morgue, it had almost turned into a pile of rotting bones and flesh.

The next story is an extremely thrilling case that occurred last winter.

tom_tat: The number is that there is a large bridge on the outskirts of the city. I heard people report: “Someone hanged himself on this bridge!”. When we arrived at the scene, we saw that the suicide was a woman. Through the autopsy, it can be seen that the person's determination to commit suicide...
noi_dung:
3. People with poisonous tongues

At midnight, I received an order from my superiors:

– Must rush to the work scene immediately!

The number is that there is a large bridge on the outskirts of the city. I heard people report: “Someone hanged himself on this bridge!”. When we arrived at the scene, we saw that the suicide was a woman. Through examination, it can be seen that the person's determination to commit suicide was very high (the rope was so tight that the neck bones were broken).

Investigating his background, we found out that the deceased lived nearby (that's not the end of the story, because there's still a scary scene waiting for us)...

When we arrived at the suspect's house, we were startled to see the naked body of a baby less than a year old on the bed. When the police arrived, the child's father still did not know that his wife had committed suicide. He was still crying and groaning, blaming his wife loudly and telling the police everything.

It turned out that the situation was not complicated, the husband went out drinking with his friends, and the wife stayed home alone to take care of the children. chanting mantra sutras, meditation, visualization... Thanks to that, we wholeheartedly recite Buddha's name at every moment: Walk, stand, sit, lie down... Thanks to understanding and deeply believing that: If you dedicate your mind to reciting, you will be reborn, so I steadfastly rest assured in Buddha's recitation, and then actively introduce this method to everyone.

THE LATE NIGHT CALL

This year me28 years old, after several years of passionate love, every day28/5/2011, My boyfriend and I walked hand in hand down the wedding hall. At this time, I must say that I am immersed in overwhelming happiness. One day at the end of August, I went home to visit my mother.

I accidentally heard my mother tell me, I don't know who it was, every night at 10:05 p.m. they were downstairs calling my name! After listening, I was scared because I thought it was too strange, so I kept asking my mother:

– Did mom mishear or have hallucinations or something?…

My mother affirmed:

-There is absolutely no room for mishearing. When I first heard it, my mother thought that there were many people named Oanh in this area and thought it must be a coincidence, so she didn't pay attention. But over time, my mother had to pay attention, because I saw this happening again and again, for the past three months.

Now I remember, secretly admiring my mother's bravery, because during that time, every night before 10 p.m., she went up to the terrace and looked down, looking around hoping to discover who was playing evil tricks?... She waited for a long time but didn't see anything, but when she entered the house, the female voice rang out at exactly 10:05 p.m. calling my name.

Reluctantly, my mother had to tell me this story. At that time, I was both worried and scared... I also thought that it could have been done by some treacherous bandits, but under this sky, how could such a strange thing happen?

My heart was full of questions and worries, afraid that something bad would happen to my mother. I also wanted to verify the truth... So I decided to sleep at my mother's house that night.

I stared at the clock hanging on the wall, the steady tick-tock-tick sound resounded, my heart was restless and extremely agitated. To reduce anxiety, my mother and I waited and talked...

At exactly 10:05 p.m., my ears clearly heard the gentle sound of a woman calling my name. My whole body suddenly became goosebumps and I sweated profusely. At this time without an appointment, my mother and I blurted out the same sentence:

– Do you hear that?

That's right! In the end, I had to believe that the strange thing was real! It turns out that in this world there is also a thing called "The devil calling at the door!"...

I was extremely confused, confused, and extremely scared and frightened! But that calling voice felt very familiar and familiar to me...

That night I completely couldn't sleep, or more accurately, "didn't dare sleep", because I was so scared... All night long I sat in bed, not daring to sleep, I was so scared. Honestly, I've never heard anyone talk about this incident. I was overwhelmed by panic, making my mind exhausted. I fell asleep a little past midnight and dreamed of a skinny woman with short hair, holding a big pile of money in front of her chest. I was about to approach her, but she immediately threw me a look full of hatred... Just like that, I endured until morning. I'm really scared, I don't understand what this is all about?

When morning came, I went to find the teacher and asked him to take a look. They didn't see the reason, they just said "It seems like this person has come to demand his life".... and warned me not to let my mother go out at night, otherwise it would be dangerous and not guaranteed to be safe. In addition, the teacher told me to go home and use five types of grains to prevent this female demon. I did exactly as the teacher told me, but I didn't see any effect, I still heard the call.

At this time, it was almost the Mid-Autumn Festival, and the teacher said that if you don't hear your name called again in the Mid-Autumn Festival, you won't be called again in the future. But that strange sound keeps calling my name every night non-stop, I don't understand what it is?

In the blink of an eye, it's the 9th day of the 8th lunar month, with just a few days left until the Mid-Autumn Festival. My insides were hot like fire, afraid something bad would happen to my mother. My father passed away early, leaving only mother and child to live happily and depend on each other. I consider my mother as my life, without her, how can I face the remaining days?

That morning, I kept calling to ask if there was any teacher who was good at guessing things. I really wanted this female ghost to leave, it seemed like she had an extremely grudge against me. I was enthusiastically told by my friends and gave me the address of a troubleshooter. At this time, I was very confused and often asked myself: "I don't understand what I did wrong, if anything..." then I don't know what to do?...

During the confusion, I suddenly remembered that a few years ago I had visited a female scholar who had a very good interpretation ability. So I decided to go to this lady's house. Because it was a long time ago, I don't remember her very well. After contacting by phone, she made an appointment for me to leave after 11:00 am. So after 11 o'clock, I arrived on time.

When I got there, I realized that this girl followed Buddhism. The house is airy and clean, and there is a statue that looks very familiar, but I don't recognize it. After I presented my story, the female scholar (let's call her Lan) told an anecdote that had sworn for thousands of years, solving this doubt for me.

Then the first question I asked was:

– Is my mother in any danger? (Because I worry about my mother the most). Ms. Lan replied:

– Not at all!

Only then did I feel reassured and breathe a sigh of relief. After that, Ms. Lan calmed down for a moment and told the story of my past life. Please briefly summarize as follows:

“In the first generation of the Zhou dynasty, we were originally husband and wife, the person (calling my name every night now) was a man at that time, working as Prime Minister. I have a female body, a concubine. Nhưng tôi lại giết chết phu quân, tạo thành nghiệt duyên oan trái đời thứ nhất.

The second generation belonged to the Tang Dynasty, the other was the master, the servant was the servant. I listened to the instigators and killed the boss.

Until this present life, he is a ghost, coming to claim my life." Ms. Lan also wrote me a poem, the last two sentences are very thoughtful, like: “See Bodhi again for peace, help me resolve this resentment”…

Ms. Lan asked me:

– Do you want to resolve it?

I quickly nodded. Obeying her words, I did not have any thoughts in my mind, I only thought of one thing: Will definitely do and do well all requests. At that time, she asked me to kneel in front of the Bodhisattva statue. I couldn't stop crying. I don't know why I kept wanting to cry? She gave me a three-day deadline, forcing me to recite three thousand verses of Amitabha Buddha every day and recite two repentance sutras. She also gave me a book of "Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva Samantabhadra" and "Vajra Sutra" and also recited the mantra for me. Even though I didn't understand it, when I recited Amitabha Buddha's name, my tears fell profusely and I choked up...

After that, Ms. Lan said:

– Rest assured! He won't come again tonight...

At that time, I was half-believing and half-skeptical. Even though I was sincere, this was the first time I encountered something like this, and I was full of doubts...

It was late afternoon when I left Ms. Lan's house and returned. My friends and I were eating and discussing this matter. Her companion spoke:

– I don't know if it has any effect, but I don't believe it anyway!

Right when my friend said that, a poem suddenly appeared in my heart: “See Bodhi again for your safety… Help me resolve this resentment"...

I explained to my friend, but her face was still full of doubt...

No matter how my friends criticize or discourage me, I still maintain my stance: “If you promise, you must do it!”

After dinner, I went to my mother and told her everything that had just happened. My mother was also full of doubts and questions, thinking that this was beyond her expectations. She said that in her more than half of her life, this was the first time she encountered something strange like this. No one believed it, even I myself was skeptical, but I still had to do it. Because of my mother, I had to do it!

Saying goodbye to my mother, I returned to my home. My husband was very worried about me but could not believe such strange things. So he doesn't talk much about this.

That night, I was alone at home, silently rereading Ms. Lan Bien's poem and remembering the stories of my past lives written in it, unable to hold back the tears that flowed down my face.

I was extremely sad, thinking to myself: “How could I commit such a big crime? Being able to have a human body is very difficult, very precious...yet I cruelly killed them twice, why was I so cruel?"...

So I cried again, silently wondering why he didn't wake me up sooner? I felt extremely miserable, so I opened the Repentance Sutra and recited it with tears falling profusely.

Then I went to stay at my mother's house for three days. On the way, my mouth kept chanting Buddha! At my mother's place, I took care of chanting sutras repentance. Even though my mind was highly stressed, while sitting on the bed I kept chanting Buddha's name, and for some reason I felt like crying. Looking up at the clock, I saw it was already 10:30 p.m. Today I really don't hear the sound calling my name anymore. Late at night, I fell asleep. In my dream, I saw the girl holding my hand, looking happy and cheerful, her eyes looking as if to say: “Great job!”… I spent a peaceful night.

Waking up in the morning, my mind is temporarily calm, but I'm still a little worried. At night, seeing my mother busy working, I felt very panicked and sad. I just wanted to be quiet, so I told her to stop working and recite Buddha's name with me. At this point I discovered: The wind blew in gusts, very cold. It was so cold that I had goosebumps and sweat all over my body. I asked:

– Mom, did you open the window?

She replied:

– No!

My hands were cold, I felt like the negative energy was rushing to cover me, he came to my side. It seems he doesn't trust me. I told him to rest assured and respectfully promised that I would recite Buddha well. To pray for him to escape the sea of suffering, I asked him to believe me.

I chanted Buddha while crying, chanting until my mind became peaceful and happy, able to smile. At this time, my hand gradually became warm again.

On the third morning (this is the last day), I decided to try to recite Buddha and repentance a lot. In the morning I recited ten times, two in the afternoon, two in the evening. During these three days I always kept in touch with Ms. Lan. When I went to meet Ms. Lan, she gave me the book "Retribution for Life" by layperson Guo Qing (Quả Khanh). I read that there are many great cause and effect stories here... I think“I should chant the Ksitigarbha sutras dedicating merit to those who have been murdered and hurt by me.“… So that night I recited the five sutras.

That night I slept very peacefully, but one thing I forgot was that on the afternoon of the second day, something strange happened. At that time, I had the idea that I really wanted to listen to music reciting Amitabha Buddha, so I went online to search... I sat in front of the computer quietly listening with tears streaming down my face, because I felt like a sinner... So I immediately knelt down, expressing my repentance. Only then did I pay attention and discover: The computer screen was vibrating violently, and I was in tears. At this moment, a scene suddenly appeared on the computer: I was holding two types of fruit, bananas and grapes, going to Ms. Lan's house. I didn't understand what this meant, so I didn't pay much attention...

The matter was finally resolved, and on the third day, I could no longer hear the female ghost screaming. I was filled with gratitude, so on the 14th day of the lunar calendar, I went to buy grapes and bananas to thank Ms. Lan (exactly like the scene I saw on the computer yesterday). Ms. Lan told me to pay my respects to the Buddha statue. When I worshiped him, my heart was extremely moved, I was so moved that I wanted to cry, it felt very strange.

On the afternoon of the 14th lunar day, my husband and I went to visit my mother. My husband bought donkey meat to eat. Normally I like it very much and can eat seven or eight pieces... But that day, by the time I got to the fourth bite, I couldn't eat anymore. Then my stomach suddenly hurt, causing me to vomit violently.

Then I thought: “It's dead! Did I make another mistake?"

The next day was the Mid-Autumn Festival (full moon day of the 8th month), and I had a terrible nightmare: In the dream is a vast abyss, so deep that you can't see the bottom, in which a female ghost's scolding voice can be heard:

– If you keep living like this, when will I be able to escape suffering? Prepare for your death!…

I sat up in horror, it wasn't quite dawn yet. Glancing at my husband sleeping soundly next to me, I gently adjusted my body and chanted: “Amitabha Buddha! Please give me the answer, how scary was the dream just now, did I do something bad?”…

After reciting Buddha's name for a while, I fell asleep. In my dream, a verse appeared. As soon as I woke up, I hastily wrote it down, but I couldn't remember it all. I only remember four words clearly: “A VEGAN MEMORIAL TO Buddha!”

In the morning, on the full moon day of Mid-Autumn Festival, I told my mother everything and declared that from now on I would be a vegetarian. The whole family wondered why I refused to eat meat. My mother, who loves and takes care of me very much, guessed that I probably wanted to lose weight...

Seeing people eating meat and drinking wine, I didn't crave it at all. Just like that, I have been a vegetarian until now without even craving salt.

The family gradually calmed down, and my mother's mood also improved. Before, my mother was very brave, but now every time she goes to the rooftop, she feels a little scared.

When she is at work, she also takes the time to recite Buddha's name! She said her mind is much better now. Even though my husband doesn't believe it, he doesn't object to me being a vegetarian and reciting Buddha's name. He just needs me to be safe and okay.

Since coming into contact with the Buddha Dharma until now, it has been more than a month. In the past, I diligently practiced because I was unfairly collected by a debtor. Recently, thanks to listening to the teachings of the Buddha Dharma, my heart was filled with tears that could not be contained.

I am a successful young person, with enough fame and money in my hands... After going through this, I understand the relationships between people, and also see that life and love are very precious. Most importantly, I truly realized and felt that the Buddha Dharma has great, unimaginable power - this made me deeply moved -

I deeply believe in cause and effect retribution, the events that happened have educated me and helped me understand the meaning of life, as well as know "to be tolerant of others' mistakes, strict with yourself, to live respectfully to parents, to do whatever is beneficial to myself and others".

When studying Buddhism, I always pay attention to overcoming and adjusting every small defect of myself. Of course this repair process requires continuous and persistent practice over a long period of time - Because no matter what you do, there must always be Buddha in your mind.

4. Mr. Lieutenant General

One time, Lieutenant General Lu Gu came to see me and said:

– Master Lien, I heard you were very good at predicting, so today I came to ask for advice… I remember at that time, my parents went to ask Master Diep (also the king of math, famous for his unerring prophecy), to read my destiny.

Mr. Diep said that when I was 18 years old, I passed the national valedictorian exam, then joined the army and was recruited to the Research Institute. At 27 years old, I got my doctorate and then went to America for three years and got another doctorate. At the age of 53, I was promoted to Senior Lieutenant General.

Lu Co added:

- This person with the surname Diep, unlike other teachers, whoever wants him to tell his fortune for him has to pay a very high price, and he also has to queue up and make an appointment in advance. If he comes casually, he won't even bother to see! But he doesn't watch anyone with a small destiny! Mr. Diep checked it for me very accurately! It's true that in 18 I won the national valedictorian award, but I guessed that in 27 I got my doctorate, but I was a little wrong (because it took me two years later, at the age of 29, to get my doctorate). As for the prophecy, I went to America for three years and got another doctorate, that's right! But he said that at the age of 53, I was promoted to Senior General, but he was wrong! Because I am now 56 years old and still a Lieutenant General, I have not yet reached the position of Senior General. So, I would like to ask Master Lien to look at it for me, why haven't I been promoted to Senior General?

I used the method of divination to read Lu Co's hexagrams. After I pressed the seal and chanted the mantra, the God of Fortune appeared like a small star, growing larger and radiating a bright halo... I immediately asked about Mr. Lu's fate in his life. Than Phuc Loc replied exactly as Mr. Diep had predicted.

I wonder:

– But why was it two years late for Mr. Lu to get his doctorate?

Than Phuc Loc explains:

- Mr. Lu could have gotten his degree as predicted, but when he was young, after a round of drinking, he and his friends took each other to a brothel to have fun. Listening to his friends' urging, he also wanted to prove that he was a brave and willing player, so he slept with a prostitute. Because of this mistake, my career was delayed by two years!

I asked:

– Why is that?

Than Phuc Loc said:

– "Don't come to see the courtesan, don't come to the gate of a half-beautiful lady." You must know that a gentleman always loves his body and always keeps his virtue as clear as jade, so he is very afraid and very afraid of these nonsense things! Because Mr. Lu did not understand, he was doomed to fall, causing his own conduct to be blemished, causing his life to be polluted. Because of his wrong way of life, he lost his fortune and his body, and his sexual addiction not only caused gonorrhea infection, but also caused great disaster...

Than Phuc Loc also explains further:

– Getting your degree two years late is just a small punishment. If infected with poison, you will die. Receiving a doctorate and then another... but it will work out later... Death!

I lost my ability to speak. Ask Than Phuc Loc again:

– Lu Co was actually promoted to Lieutenant General at the age of 53, but why is he now 56 years old and still a Lieutenant General? Why hasn't he been promoted yet?

Than Phuc Loc silently wrote two words: MAC THU.

I asked confusedly:

– Mac Thu? – What does that mean?

Than Phuc Loc replied:

– It's your name!

– Is this person related to Mr. Lu?

- Of course!

Than Phuc Loc said:

– Co Lu's fate was very good, he was a genius in the world, both civil and martial arts. But unfortunately, when he was young, he made the mistake of sleeping with a prostitute and delayed his career by two years. This is just a small punishment! After middle age, he did not know how to repent and change, and again developed an evil mind and a preference for male beauty: had a homosexual relationship with a man named Mac Thu. This person is handsome and talented, handsome and elegant, and is a subordinate under your command! Lu Co has been living with Mac Thu for eight years now. Having made this mistake, he is lucky to still be able to hold the position of Lieutenant General. Can he dream of becoming a Lieutenant General? He only knows how to seek fortune for himself, completely unaware of the hardship he is creating! You must know that a person with a lot of blessings who commits sexual immorality will have their rights and fortune reduced, while a person with little blessings who has no fortune or power will lose their life span...

I asked:

– So… What is Lu Gu's future?

- Will apply to his descendants!

– What does that mean?

– Extinction, premature death! Than Phuc Loc replied.

– But everyone has to bear the burden, why do children and grandchildren have to bear the burden?

– This is a karma coin. Father's blessings also add to himself and his children!

After hearing this, I was very scared.

First, I just told Uncle Lu the reason why he got his degree two years late.

Lu Co said:

– There is this thing. When I was young, I played with friends and were invited by them, so we went out to have fun. I didn't expect that being tricked would have such bad consequences, it was truly unexpected!

I explained again why he could not be a Lieutenant General. I wrote the reason with two words "Mac Thu". As soon as he looked at it, he bowed his head and remained silent, not saying a word.

I asked:

– Does this happen?

He nodded and replied:

– Yes!

Then Lu Co stood up and told me:

– Lien Sinh, you are truly a prophet king, predicting things like a god! I finally understand, although human destiny is predetermined, it can change! Changing back and forth, it's all created by the mind!

– Very well said! I hope you understand, and from now on, take care to correct yourself well to avoid bad retribution!

When Lu Co left, I gave him a piece of paper with a few reminders:

Men and women live together

That's right - no mistakes are tolerated!

Evil actions cause deep harm...

We all suffered, we lost our fortunes

Tu Venerable is extinct - it's troublesome

Buried money and money, forever stored in sorrow

Stop and be alert quickly

Avoid letting your children get into accidents

As humans, we should live straight

Cause and effect retribution is not wrong, clear!

Not long after that, Lu's only son was hit and killed by a car. As for him, he also suffered a tragedy, he was truly extinct as expected!

noi_dung:
5. Director Vien Mau

Yuan Mau was the director of a metal factory. In the past, when he came to ask about his fate, God of Fortune replied:

– Fifteen years later he will become a rich businessman.

As a result, more than ten years later, Vien Mau lost money and had to close his business. Due to borrowing too much capital, he was in debt and had to go abroad to escape debt. Since then, he has lived in exile, never vowing to return to his country.

Vien Mau's life abroad was very difficult. He had a small business and had very little income. He had to apply for a job as a construction worker. He used to be a factory director. Now he had to crawl up and down on people's roofs. Because he was not good at his skills, he was fired. Vien Mau then applied for a job in the kitchen to make ends meet.

Then Vien Mau heard that I had settled abroad, so he followed the cart to find me. He stayed on the swaying cart for three days and two nights before reaching me.

The morning I met him, I was startled. In the past, Vien Mau, dressed in a luxurious suit, his hair combed smoothly, left the house in a shiny car, escorted by a driver and secretary... But Vien Mau now has a salt-and-pepper hair, a face full of wrinkles, a dirty look, a slovenly appearance, an austere appearance, a depressed and despondent appearance, and a lack of mind to the point of karma...

I invited him into the house, poured tea for him, gave him breakfast, and looked like he hadn't eaten anything yet.

Vien Mau asked:

– You said I would be a rich man in 15 years. Is this the time?

– So how many years has it been now?

Vien Mau replied:

– Just turned 15!

Then he added further criticism:

- Obviously that's not true, guessing is nonsense!...

– I… (stiff throat, speechless).

Vien Mau's face showed resentment and discomfort, and he asked:

– Why is the fortune-telling not correct, it is so incomprehensible?

– That is…

Vien Mau recounted:

– In the past, when I was still a glorious director, I also invited him to my company to see feng shui, design, and edit every good place just like he taught... I also asked him to check my numbers, and he affirmed that 15 years later, I would definitely become very wealthy and achieve ultimate success, at the highest level in life. It's been exactly 15 years now, nothing has happened, on the contrary, it's even more miserable! How do you answer this??

-I… (sweating all over)…

Vien Mau says:

– Now I'm at the end of my rope, what do you think I should do?

Let me review it for you, okay?…

– Guess, see, again?… What the hell does it look like? Vien Mau said angrily.

I closed my eyes… suddenly saw Than Phuc Loc, holding a child in each hand...

I asked: Who is this child?

Than Phuc Loc replied:

- It's all Vien Mau's children!

– A! I understand, Yuan Mau for more than ten years has been killing people, having abortions... That's why there are two dead children.

So I shouted:

– Vien Mau, you committed murder, your lover aborted two children...

Vien Mau replied:

– That's right! But is the crime of abortion that serious?

God Phuc Loc appeared again, shook his head and looked at me, he raised his hand and pointed to the sky, a hermitage appeared in the air, a beautiful and graceful nun walked out, holding two children in her hand...

Right there I panicked (because I understood all the reasons)...

I said:

– Vien Mau! He sowed the cause of short life, committing the great crime of dishonoring monks. This is the reason why he lost his luck and fortune and fell into extreme misfortune! The two babies were born to her, right?

At this moment, Vien Mau's face turned pale and he was sweating all over! he stammered:

– But… That nun also likes me!

– Oh my god! – I sighed – you must know this is a big taboo! In monasteries there are precepts, there are Dharma Protectors... Monks are those who have made vows to leave the secular world and live a pure spiritual life. If you try to seduce a monk, the crime will increase one level. It was because he acted uncontrollably, daring to have sexual intercourse with the nun to the point of having two children and even destroying and killing them... No matter how big and serious this crime is, you are in the same dead end as you are now, because you brought it upon yourself!

– Is that right?

- Of course! – I replied.

– So what should I do?

- You must take an oath to strictly uphold the Buddha's forbidden precepts, vowing to correct and innovate from now on. You should reveal all your mistakes before the Buddha, sincerely bow to repentance a lot... And from now on, every time a thought arises, you must be careful and cautious, vowing absolutely not to commit adultery again. We must forever cut off the roots of our sins, always act righteously and truly enter the path of correct reformation. Not only that, in the future you must always keep good thoughts in your mind, you must always (orally or in writing) advise secular people not to commit adultery and absolutely not give rise to evil thoughts towards monks. The Buddha Sutra teaches: “Those who observe the precepts do not commit adultery, increase the five blessings, and do not fall into the three evil paths”… He must make an effort to repentance, become a vegetarian, chant sutras diligently, do good deeds... only hope for redemption and an end to crime. Particularly for monks, we must wholeheartedly support and assist them in maintaining their chastity and purity. Because the purpose of a monk is to attain enlightenment and escape birth and death, in the “Four Commandments of Pure Conduct” in the Shurangama Sutra, Buddha gave very clear instructions to monks: “You must cut off and eliminate lust!” This is the first indispensable condition of a practitioner, lust is definitely not retained. Because if you continue to nurture this mind, you will definitely get lost in the path of demons. If you or anyone else has an evil mind and wants to harass monks, it is a demonic practice, the retribution after death will be extremely dire...

After listening, Vien Mau promised to follow suit. I give you a few verses of caution:

People who have practiced practice have emerged from this world

Let's enjoy love

Destroying the morality of practitioners

Not letting the Buddha family be pure

God's eyes see extremely clearly

Men and women secretly have feelings

Evil and terrible retribution!

Man, hurry up and fix your mistakes!

I sent Vien Mau away and gave him two thousand dollars as capital, hoping that from now on he would be determined to practice, forever correct his mistakes, and innovate. Vien Mau's story reminds me of the movie "Birds hiding and waiting to die" about the love affair between a true priest and a young woman, this girl always aroused thoughts towards the priest and had the desire to conquer...

Nowadays, movies, books, and other forms of media are very fond of promoting failed love relationships and considering them to be romantic, and love to show them, post them, promote them... Regardless of whether the story is true or not, this is a disgraceful practice, shameful for practice... Doing so is very harmful to the social atmosphere...

If a cultivator commits adultery, based on cause and effect, he must understand that the consequences will be dire and terrifying. Because you understand the Dharma but still violate it.

As for ordinary people, the Buddha Sutra says: “The person who commits sexual immorality will receive retribution: his wife (husband) will be unfaithful, will die and fall into the three evil realms, become animals, hungry ghosts, and hell. Hundreds of thousands of lives, it's not easy to escape, you can't be human anymore”… This is not a threat, but completely true!

Not to mention the distant retribution of hell, just describing the flowers of the leopard, in this very life, a person who commits sexual precepts will lose his position, his reputation will be ruined, and his property will be destroyed! People who indulge in sexual immorality will suffer from many diseases, easily become old and weak, will not live long, will be reviled by society, will have deep hatred, and will eventually lose their reputation!

I suddenly thought of the women and men seducing monks and the messy and unhealthy relationships between people in the religion or between religion and life. Love stories that should not, are not allowed... but it's not like there isn't any. (Of course, monks are unenlightened people, ordinary people, not saints, who is without fault?) But I would like to remind you: If you have developed the mind to practice, as a person leaving the home life, then try your best to observe the precepts as if you were saving your life. You must clearly understand that lust brings unpredictable and dire consequences. This mistake should absolutely not be underestimated, cannot be considered a joke or play!

Please remember the real stories I have told and be vigilant. You must constantly repent of your mistakes, practice diligently, and strictly maintain precepts to atone for wrong thoughts, then that sin can be eliminated.

The precept of lust is one of the four important precepts of Buddha. The saints and sages all soon realized the pain of lust, so they gave up worldly pleasures to achieve pure Ultimate Bliss.

As for good books and scriptures that are useful for the human mind and world, they should be praised, supported, and widely spread throughout life. We must clearly understand that chasing after physical pleasure is useless. If we indulge in lust, we will fall into ultimate suffering. You should not joke around and rush along, nor should you be crazy about praising...

Maintaining a pure mind contributes to a good and peaceful society... If the atmosphere is maintained well, people's hearts will be pure. Take yourself as an example in everything. Please keep yourself pure and virtuous as clear as jade! Absolutely do not do things that are harmful to your body and mind. There is nothing worse than sexual immorality. Not harboring evil thoughts is cultivating oneself!
