Lien Sinh

LND. I find it very interesting that in the opening sentence the author says: “Actually, at the beginning of our human life, our blessings and destiny may be very great… but because our understanding of cause and effect is so poor, we have: unintentionally destroying your own happiness – with unvirtuous thoughts, words, and actions”…

In China, there are many, many doctors who "guess lives and tell people's faces"! Of course there is real, there is fake (but fake is always more real than real). However, fortune telling is so popular in China that people only need to spend a few coins to read their whole life's destiny.

When I finished translating this story, I wondered and hesitated a lot! Because I don't know if I should release this or put it aside? Because there are some details that make me afraid...

Buddha said there are six realms: Heaven, Human, Asura, Hell, Hungry Ghosts, Animals. We only see two realms, Human and Animal, so the remaining four realms seem far away... And among humanity, there are a few who see through the invisible realm, but many see demons, but few see Heaven, Dragon, Hell...

Gods belong to the non-human realm, there are good gods and evil gods. Good spirits often promote good things and support the Buddhist world. Evil gods respond to the five desires and often promote committing evil desires (because they create blessings and cultivate, they can also become gods).

There is a saying "Buddha and ghost are separated by a thread". Such a distance is too close, so it is easy to get lost – Just start a little unrighteous thought and you will fall into the evil realm!

I see you in the story, they have many blessings, but with just one carelessness or mistake, you will suffer unexpected losses!

Yuan Mau himself made a mistake and was punished at the present time, even though it was a leopard flower (which had just bloomed and had not yet fruited) it also caused him to fall miserably. As for the nun who made a mistake, how can she explain it? – It can be said that evil and right, Buddha and ghosts are difficult to distinguish, so people who lack understanding of cause and effect and are careless, even wearing Buddha robes, can easily go astray and become ghost disciples without realizing it... If you have made a mistake and know how to admit it, sincerely repent, make efforts to cultivate virtue, and absolutely never repeat the mistake again, then evil can turn into right.

In ancient temples, there were often two deities worshiped, called Mr. Good and Mr. Evil. Mr. Evil's face is very scary, his eyes are glaring, his tongue is long... But why is it still worshiped? Because he exorcises evil and helps righteousness, eliminates evil and helps goodness.

I thought about it dozens of times, had to temporarily put this matter aside, and hesitated for three or four months... then finally decided to post it with the hope: "Who knows, maybe there will be many people who, thanks to reading it, can "stop before the abyss", will "carefully preserve their virtues, their minds... to add more blessings to yourself!?”…

After reading this story, you don't have to listen to anyone proclaiming a god and close your eyes and praise them, but you have to think and use your mind to check whether what they say is in accordance with the Buddha's five precepts, is it in accordance with the Buddha's laws? Because the Buddha's precepts were not set up to glorify Him but to protect people from living happily, not violating the law of cause and effect, and from getting mistreated.

Mr. Lieu Pham in the past, when he heard the fortune tellers predict that his destiny was too bad, he was determined to "live a good life and cultivate virtue to change the fate" and prove "your destiny is in your hands!".

After reading this story, if you are alert and keep your body, speech, and mind, and worry about establishing virtue and cultivating virtue, it is very precious. But if you keep waiting for the gods, waiting for someone to tell you what your fate will be so that you can believe it and then go downhill, sad and happy according to what the "teacher" says, that is a very bad thing!

There are also people who claim to be immortals and saints, boasting of supernatural powers, but belong to the evil class that enters the body - as described in the "Sangrim Sutra" (there are up to fifty types of five skandhas!) - It is easy to distinguish them, because these evil people often like to slander the precepts, praise salty eating, sexual immorality, indulging in alcohol, meat... They always promote their ego, claiming to have attained sainthood but are easily angry, and do everything with the aim of defrauding money and making profits...

The character Lien Sinh here has a gentle mind, he always aims to help people improve their virtue. He even spent money to help Vien Mau rebuild his life.

I have witnessed many families enjoying wealth, blessings and power... ultimate, but just because of this sin of sexual desire, he fell into ruin, had a short life, and lost his family. Please forgive me for translating and faithfully giving you this story without omitting any details. I hope that everyone knows how to cherish their existing blessings and protect themselves well, so that their blessings will increase day by day and their virtues will become clearer.

THAI MINH Thong

Not long ago, Mr. Thai Minh Thong told me his family's true story of retribution:

Minh Thong's great-grandfather was very rich, had abundant land, and raised buffaloes for farming.

One day, my great-grandfather was piercing the calf's nose. It was in so much pain that he threw his leg and kicked it in a dangerous place, causing the owner's death. Grandfather Minh Thong saw that his father had died miserably. He was so angry that he immediately took a mace and was determined to beat the little buffalo to death.

When the mother buffalo saw its owner holding a weapon, she quickly knelt down and roared in pain, her eyes filled with tears, begging the owner not to kill her child, but Grandfather Minh Thong's anger was so high that it was difficult to control, so he kept hitting the little buffalo's head with a mace, causing blood to splatter and the calf falling to the ground... His grandfather immediately cut off its limbs and hung its body on a tree. The buffalo was still alive but he skinned it, cut off pieces of meat, and tortured it to the extreme. Because farmers here don't eat buffalo meat, he just cuts the meat and throws it randomly on the ground, letting it rot and give birth to maggots. The buffalo was brutally abused and endured this pain for three days before it died.

After that, grandfather Minh Thong dreamed of a baby telling him:

You caused me to soon be separated from my mother's love, and cruelly stripped my skin and mutilated my flesh... After I suffered for three days before I died, I vowed to take revenge, causing three generations of your family to live without peace and suffer the "death of the family".

After that, my grandfather got married and had a son (Minh Thong's father). He was only three years old when his wife passed away. Three years later, my grandfather passed away.

Minh Thong's father grew up, got married and gave birth to Minh Thong. When Minh Thong was three years old, his mother left home without reason. When Minh Thong was six years old, his father passed away. In both generations, the Thai family had to leave his biological mother early and suffer abuse from his stepmother.

Currently, Minh Thong's grandparents and parents have all passed away. After Minh Thong got married, he also gave birth to two children, but when the eldest son was three years old, the second son was one year old; When his eldest son was six years old, he divorced his ex-wife and married his new wife.

When he was young, Thai Minh Thong was hit in the head by his younger brother, causing serious injuries. Now there is still a dent in the head. Normally, when people walk on the road, their legs and thighs must be straight to be able to walk easily, but every time he walks, because the cartilage in his knee keeps protruding, he often gets bumped on the road, so he has to have surgery to remove that bone. Not only that, when he was serving in the army, he suddenly developed a stomach ache and was misdiagnosed by the doctor as: "Residual intestinal pain, urgent surgery required." But when injecting the medicine, they accidentally damaged his spinal nerves, making him not only unable to bend but also unable to stand for long periods of time.

After being discharged from the army, he had an accident and broke his leg. Now because the steel pillar is attached inside, movement is even more inconvenient. And yet, before going to sleep, he always had to ask his wife to bring a mace to hit his feet before he could sleep, every day.

Minh Thong affirmed: I am my grandfather reincarnated, so my head was seriously injured, my stomach was mistakenly and painfully dissected, every night I have to experience having a hammer hit my leg before I can sleep, these phenomena are all retribution!...

This year, Thai Minh Thong is 31 years old. Thanks to attending a Buddhist retreat, he received a miraculous inspiration and was able to remember his past life and recount it to me.

Therefore, you should not kill life, you must release life and develop compassion to help poor people. If we know how to help all living beings live peacefully, our lives will also be peaceful.

Master Hue Tham told-October 30, 1982 (Excerpt from translation of Tu Van Quyen Magazine 7)

SNOW FALLS IN JUNE

Before, I always thought that this story was a famous fictional script written by Quan Han Khanh, but I never expected it to be true.

Seven or eight years ago, through a monk in the "City of Ten Thousand Buddhas", I went to Taiwan to hear Professor Truong describe in detail the strange things she had experienced.

Thirty years ago, she did charity work in Taiwan, specialized in psychological counseling, and was a pioneer in reviving the good trend for society, so the charity work commissioners in Taiwan all called her "Professor Truong". I know her real name, but here we just call her Professor Truong.

Currently, Professor Truong is in the US. I had a phone call to chat with her. She is a lay practitioner, vegetarian, speaks carefully, specializes in reciting the "Great Compassion Mantra" and reciting Buddha's name, and often travels everywhere to spread Buddha's teachings. Currently she is over 70 years old.

Before telling his story, Professor Truong opened as follows:

“There are many strange things that happened to me, I think not everyone experiences the same thing as me. But because you don't encounter these things, you can't quickly conclude that this is a myth and not true!

After listening to my story, you can criticize whatever you want, I don't dare to have an opinion. But I'm completely honest and absolutely not lying. Please believe me on this point."

This is a great story of cause and effect and retribution that writers were lucky enough to hear told by Professor Truong himself. I think those who hold high positions and hold the power of life and death in their hands should also watch it, it will be very useful. Now, I would like to record and share with you:

“Professor Truong entered university late (because she had a child and then took the exam), good karma at 33 years old (at this time she had three sons).

At the age of 33, in May she discovered she was pregnant, planning to give birth on her 34th birthday. When her mother heard this news, she firmly asked her to have an abortion. Seeing that my mother has always believed in Buddha, has been a vegetarian for many years, and always strictly observes the precepts of non-killing. But why are you asking me to have an abortion now? Mrs. Truong felt very strange. No matter how much she asked, her mother still refused to explain the reason.

When Professor Truong was pregnant, a very strange phenomenon occurred. Thứ nhất: Her body was so uncomfortable that she often had to bang her head against the wall. Thứ hai: When she vomited, she kept asking her husband and three sons to beat her, and forced them to use all their strength to beat her (so she felt comfortable). If her husband and children do not accept it, she will turn against them. This is a strange phenomenon that she has never experienced in previous pregnancies.

When Ms. Truong was in her fourth month of pregnancy, her mother's friend, a monk in Taichung, had to come to Taipei on business, so she happened to visit their house. Every time he met this monk, Professor Truong paid homage. This time, Mrs. Truong bowed and asked for one more time.

The Master asked:

– Why do you want to bow to me more?

– Yes, that is an offering on behalf of the child in the womb.

The monk happily said:

– Okay, I accept the baby. If I want you to be my disciple, if anything happens in the future, please let me know.

When the fetus was six months old, one day Professor Truong's mother wanted to eat a delicious vegetarian dish that a large restaurant in Taipei had recently sold. Professor Truong is a filial son who always wants to please his mother, so he tries his best to buy things. When she left the house and got on the bus, the strange thing was that everyone on the bus saw that she had a huge belly, but no one wanted to give up their seat, some even pretended to close their eyes so they wouldn't have to see and no one bothered to talk to her.

Therefore, Professor Truong had to stand all the time. Suddenly the car hit a heavy object and braked suddenly, causing her to fall, leading to miscarriage; had to be taken to the emergency room.

That night she had severe stomach pain. At this time the fetus was just over six months old, but she gave birth prematurely. Although the baby is still very small, it can be seen that this is an extremely beautiful and handsome baby boy.

The doctor said that because the baby was born too early, they did their best, but there is no guarantee that they can save the baby's life, so Professor Truong should not have too much hope...

Professor Truong blamed himself very much, angry at himself for not staying at home so that the child could be born safely. Currently, the baby can only lie in a glass cage. She hopes that Buddha Bodhisattva will bless and save the baby. Suddenly she remembered the monk who had stopped by her house not long ago, so she called to report:

– Dear monk, I have already given birth, the baby is still too small. But I hope I can save it.

The Master asked:

– Do you want to save it? Good! So please do as I ask. From today, start fasting for a hundred days. What sutras do you usually chant?

– Yes, I specialize in reciting the "White robe mantra".

- Okay, then you can just chant this mantra, but you have to chant it ten thousand (10,000) times. If you want to save your grandchild, put down your phone and chant it right away!

At this time, Professor Truong was at the hospital. Hearing his master's teachings, he quickly chanted the White Mantra mantra non-stop. Except when sleeping, the rest of the time is chanted all the time.

Not long after, the hospital told Professor Truong he could go home. After returning home, she sat in front of Buddha every day, chanting mantras. Every day is like that.

When the baby was one month old, that night she suddenly had a nightmare: In the dream, the baby kept pulling at her, but she pulled back. Suddenly she let go, the baby's face turned black. She woke up startled, thinking this dream must not be good, so she told her husband to call the hospital to ask how her child was doing. It was 3 am. Her husband was shy so he didn't call yet. While he was hesitant, the hospital called to inform them that the baby had just passed away at 3:00 pm.

When Professor Truong heard that, he burst into tears.

– Congratulations!

– Your illness has healed, everything is fine.

Since then, I recovered like a normal person. I only have lung disease, but I definitely won't go for any more medical treatment, because I think: "My hair has turned black. Even if the disease has not completely healed, my physical strength is still very good. Being healthy like this is enough."

Now, I can work and live normally like everyone else.

Thanks to this severe illness of mine, my father-in-law, mother-in-law, biological mother, youngest uncle, youngest aunt, younger brother, younger sister... All my relatives who witnessed me go from barely alive to healthy and now able to do anything, everyone praised: "Buddha Dharma is truly wonderful and unimaginable!".

Not only did they praise like that, but they all gathered together to eat vegetarian and recite Buddha's name. My father-in-law is 81 years old. Before 1949, he was a veteran revolutionary with many military achievements and many medals. He only believed in Chairman Mao and nothing else. But now they all do the same: Turn to vegetarianism and recite Buddha's name, practice diligently.

Uncle Hai (my husband's brother) was formerly the owner of the famous Bao Thanh restaurant. Because this is a famous restaurant, everyone knows it. Every day they kill a very large number of animals because there are always people who order at least ten tables for a party, so the shop has to kill all kinds of fresh seafood including: Fish, shrimp, crab, sea cucumber, etc. It means killing countless lives, it is impossible to count them all... and earned a lot of money.

But through my illness, Uncle Hai and his wife were determined to quit their job. They moved to Thong Hoa Street to work for others, completely giving up karma.

Since seeing my situation, not only my family members have turned to vegetarianism and reciting Buddha's name, but also my friends all over Bao Thanh district, everyone deeply believes in Buddha's teachings.

True practice is like that. I am especially grateful to my master. Since attending his Buddha retreat, I have received many benefits. Not only does the body benefit, but the mind also sublimates and advances. I learned a lot of good things from my teacher. Master's Buddha chamber not only saved my life, but also helped me follow his noble virtues (I say this correctly, because I am not a good person!). For the first time, when I heard people say:

– There was the Venerable The Hue from Taiwan who came to Mainland to organize a Buddha retreat”…

At that time, I did not believe in Buddhism and did not understand anything about Buddhism, so I was very arrogant. Even though I don't know him well, I still open my mouth to slander and gossip... I use my atheist bias to measure, imagine bad things, and then leave it up to criticism... I criticize:

– This monk is bad in all sorts of ways… There is no place!…

As soon as I wrote these lines, I felt so remorseful, I just wanted to say out loud: “Master! I sincerely apologize to you!”…

It wasn't until I was seriously ill and lying on death's door that I wanted to go to the Buddha's retreat, because I heard the blessings from the Buddha's chamber were very strong and spiritual! (I'm just going for good luck).

The evil karma I do is like killing, abortion, slandering, talking behind your back, etc. Of course, the master knows everything, he knows it very well, but he still always lovingly cares for a great evil person, a great murderer, a great karma... like me! No matter where we go or what we eat, he always saves a portion for me and explains: Trieu Le Binh is very sick and weak, please give it to her...

At Buddha, he saved my life by teaching me both harshly and tolerantly... and an arrogant atheist like me was touched and conquered by his supreme virtue... The kinder and more loving Master was, the more I felt remorseful and embarrassed, the more impressed and grateful I felt...

From then on, I sincerely attended his Buddha retreats continuously for nearly three years. In total, Master has organized more than 50 Buddha retreats. During this time, Master was not only kind to me but to everyone... That's why I respect him so much. So when my illness healed, I still wanted to attend my master's Buddha retreat, because I wanted to learn from his virtues.

When I was at Wutai Mountain, I met a girl about 16 years old from Xi'an who had a disease that made her vomit every time she ate something. Before, I was very beautiful, lovely, delicate... But since getting sick, I've gained weight rapidly, from 45 kg to 85 kg, and I'm bloated. I went everywhere looking for a teacher, because I was an orphan, without parents, so I was very pitiful.

Master also allowed me to follow him. At that time I thought: "Master, why are you doing this? This girl has an incurable disease. Take her with you. If the illness doesn't heal, it will ruin your reputation!" At that time, I thought so because I was worried about my master, but my master didn't care about this at all.

He told me: Le Binh! She's so pitiful! Please treat it like your own child and take care of it!

That girl followed and attended her master's Buddha retreats all the way to Wutai Mountain. After that, it stopped following me, because the disease was gone. He has to go home and work.

During my time following my master, I learned many valuable lessons from his virtues. Noble qualities that I have never witnessed before. So even though my illness got better and worse, I continued to attend my master's Buddha room. I really wanted to study under him. In my heart, he is a highly virtuous monk, an extremely great teacher in the world.

He made me admire and move me to tears. The more I follow my master, the more I see his virtues shining brightly, because in this worldly life, I have never met anyone with such a style. When I come into contact with an exemplary cultivator like him, I know what Buddha treasures, Dharma treasures and Sangha treasures are...

My father was a master's professor, and my mother was also a university professor. Not only did I absorb all of my parents' knowledge, but I also had high karma, so the people I came into contact with were all elite intellectuals. My youngest son is a student at Wuhan University of Agriculture and Forestry Research Institute... It can be said that all my life I have been interacting with high-class intellectuals, they are people I respect. Because there is a saying: "Ten thousand branches are low, only knowledge is supreme" (Van bang rank is low, only single book is high). This is the statement of the ancients. So in my heart, I always follow this principle, often looking and following the "highly educated world" to see if they really have the qualities of excellent and good manners as the ancient saints and sages always praise? But honestly, after contacting the master, I discovered: Master is supremely brilliant, far surpassing the intellectual elite!

Occasionally, while walking and circumambulating the Buddha, I silently confess:

– Lord Buddha! Now I have thoroughly understood and understood the sentence: "The worlds of the ten directions are seen to their fullest, necessarily non-existent like a fake Buddha!"(I looked in all the ten directions of the world and could not see anyone as wonderful as Buddha!). All Buddhas are truly compassionate and extremely great!

noi_dung:
Trieu Le Binh

THE GUEST ARRIVED EARLY

Tomorrow is the Qingming period. I've been busy since the beginning of spring and haven't had a chance to rest. I'm so tired that I have no energy left. In the afternoon, while teaching the Dharma to all the Buddhas, I was so exhausted that I couldn't breathe. I really wanted to have time to rest, but this dream seemed difficult to reach. I couldn't sleep late at night, so I decided to wake up and chant the mantra early.

As always, I pulled the curtains, opened the window... As soon as I looked outside, I was startled. Even though it was still late, the sky in the Northeast was relatively brighter than the city. Because I wasn't mentally prepared, I suddenly saw a female devil with long hair in front of me, her feet off the ground (I couldn't see her face clearly because her hair covered it all). If normally, I wouldn't be scared, but today because something happened so suddenly, I was so frightened and surprised that my mouth was open.

Calming myself for a moment, I asked the guardian gods what this was about. They explained:

– This girl often comes here, it's been quite a while, but she didn't expect to be discovered today, maybe she and someone are destined to be together.

Since we always chant sutras dedicating merit to sentient beings every day, could it be that this female demon came to listen to the chanting session early?

God told me: If you want to interact with this female devil, please calm down and talk to her with your mind.

So I immediately calmed down, closed my eyes, and used my mind to communicate... I asked the female demon mentally:

– Why do you appear shy to me?

As soon as I asked, the female devil burst into tears. I didn't understand anything and didn't know how to stop her crying. I immediately reached out to touch her and tried to comfort her. Because I had never touched a demon realm with my hands, now when I touched it I discovered a feeling of emptiness like nothingness. I was very surprised and bewildered, not knowing how to comfort her.

Looking at my bewildered attitude, the female demon started to laugh and said: I know your name, and I also know that you are always chanting sutras to pray for all sentient beings. It's been a month since I listened to the sutra. Today I wanted to come a little early, but I didn't expect someone to wake up too early and find out! Such a tired person still takes the trouble to chant sutras every day to pray for us, thank you very much!…

After a moment's pause, the female ghost told me again:

- Please recite "Namo Miraculous Body Tathagata" then immediately my shape will change well, no longer scaring you. Because I was afraid that my demon form would cause fear, that's why I deliberately let my hair down and covered my face... Please also keep a little distance from me, because our species has very strong negative energy, it will harm you, which is something I absolutely do not want...

I immediately did as the female ghost requested, clasping my hands together and chanting "Namo Miraculous Body Tathagata" ten times. Miracle appears: The female ghost immediately turned beautiful, her hair neatly lifted up, allowing me to see her face clearly: She looks very lovely.

The female ghost asked me to recite many Buddha names for her in the future, because it is very beneficial for sentient beings. Next she told me that she was born in this locality and at the age of 19 jumped from a building to her death. She said that she is currently a lonely and unjust soul. Due to the crime of suicide, she cannot be reincarnated and must live in the underworld, suffering as a ghost wandering around in the human world.

I asked: Why didn't she fall into hell?

She replied:

– My evil karma is not worthy of going to hell. But even if I don't go to hell, the suffering I have to go through is no different from hell. Because every day, at the exact moment I committed suicide, I had to repeat the exact same thing again, meaning I had to continue standing upstairs and jumping down to commit suicide, experiencing the excruciatingly painful feeling of being lost. I have had to act out this scene of jumping from a building for 10 years, every day I have to re-enact the scene of suicide like that, the suffering is indescribable, not to mention the life of kneeling unsatisfactorily, suffering from hunger and thirst, ten thousand times more miserable than being a human being. If I had known this, I wouldn't have committed suicide!

The female kneel said that ten years ago, after her parents divorced, the court ruled that she should return to live with her mother. But her mother was profane, so she had a stepfather. Then, because this corrupt stepfather raped her, she told her biological mother, but not only did she not believe her, she also kicked her out of the house. So she angrily stood from the top of her house, jumped down and committed suicide... She also told me the address of her house, saying that if you don't believe me, I can investigate and verify!

She said:

– Isn't it true that you released your disciples near my house? Because it's only eleven houses away from my mother's house.

(That afternoon, I sent my disciples to investigate the matter, and indeed found the ghost girl's mother's house. When asked, neighbors also confirmed that this really happened.)

The female demon told me again how she took revenge on her mother and stepfather – making her stepfather suffer from malignant cancer, and her mother had to divorce. She cried as she told the story, complaining why she told her mother in a dream, asked her to chant sutras for her, but she didn't believe it?

She told me that she caused her mother to be tormented by wild demons, her body was not at peace, and she was miserable day and night... She wanted her mother to believe in cause and effect, to repent of the sins she herself had done, to escape suffering in the future…

I'm touched that you trust me, thank you for telling me the truth. I was very sad because I found her so pitiful. She's only 19 years old, but why is she so fat...

I advised her to let go of her resentment and promised to send a disciple to find her mother. I explained that my health is not good right now, so I want to stay at home to rest. I will ask my disciples to contact your mother, because we have never known her. If we tell you everything clearly about your situation and wishes, your mother will definitely understand and believe, clarifying the cause and effect.

After hearing this, she was very happy and even boasted that she had heard me chanting the Ksitigarbha sutras for a month, and in about 6 months she would be born in heaven, to a very beautiful place...

She also said: People in the world today are just as stupid as I was in the past! Even though they have a human body, most of them do not know how to cherish it. Therefore, you must write down and clearly describe my suffering for everyone to know, advise them not to commit suicide, and understand that the retribution of suicide is very scary, very painful - unimaginable! - Being able to have a human body is very rare and you don't know it. If you continue to be ignorant and leave your human body and fall into the demon world, you will suffer countless times! This suffering is unspeakable. Luckily, thanks to other people and monks chanting the Ksitigarbha sutras to guide the unjust souls of the ghosts, I still have the good fortune to listen and be able to ascend to heaven in the future...

Having finished speaking, she told me:

– The cock is crowing, I have to go now, because I can't see my temple!

After the female ghost left, my mind became heavy and I thought to myself: "People today only believe in what their eyes see, completely unaware of their illness being caused by an unjust bondholder seeking revenge or revenge... People go to the hospital every day, but don't know how to stay at home so chanting sutras, releasing life, repentance, sincerely repenting... Worry about purifying your body, speech, and mind, restoring goodness, to atone for the sins you have committed... Even if they are willing to practice, if they just recite a few sutras and don't see any results, they quickly conclude: Buddha deceived people, then threw away all his practice! Why don't they think about how many cruel crimes they have committed over many lifetimes? People often want to take in everything they do and refuse to give it out!”…

Right now I'm very tired of communication. Because I tend to speak frankly, I easily offend many people. But did you know? Nowadays there aren't many people who speak the truth!

I write like that without any other intention, I just want to say that constructive words that help you perfect your virtue should be carefully listened to and absorbed. Tomorrow is the Qingming Festival, there will be a lot of people burning joss paper on the side of the road, but I don't feel happy at all! Do you know why? Because I think instead of burning votive paper, you should recite many Ksitigarbha sutras dedicating merit to the deceased, then your ancestors and relatives will receive many benefits! If you can reform yourself, be a vegetarian, do good deeds, release animals, giving, chanting sutras… If you dedicate that merit to your relatives for many generations, eliminate karma and transcend all deceased relatives, then this is true grave unfilial transgression!

As I was writing here, I suddenly heard that the old man downstairs had passed away, and the children paid tribute by hiring an entire band of musicians and playing instruments and drums: Loud performances, full of both old and new songs...

My eyes suddenly became wet: 'Oh my God, when will people understand and practice true filial piety?' Looks like that loud band playing today will disturb me and the whole neighborhood all night long!

noi_dung:
Chan Ngu

LND:Previously, when I heard Mr. Hsuan Hua preach that people who commit suicide die and have to re-enact their suicide scene every day, I was skeptical and did not believe it, but now this story has made me ponder... Furthermore, the Buddha Sutra says: "The Buddha's name has infinite and wonderful power, inspired by the merit of their perfect practice and great vows." We in the human world, if we want to verify it, it is our personal experience that we know for ourselves. Because it is not universal, few people understand it clearly.

When translating the story to the place where the female demon asked to recite "Namo Dieu Dieu Tathagata's Body" - one of the seven Buddhas mentioned by name in the article "Alms of Food Offering to the Dead", her face immediately changed for the better - proving that the ancient monk, when compiling this sutra, understood the magic of the Holy Names. In the human realm, we do not see clear and fast transformations like the demon realm: That is, when repentance ceremonies are held, invisible sentient beings come to listen to the sutras and develop joyful, wholesome minds. Thanks to that, their bodies will change for the better. If they are hungry ghosts, they will be well-fed and even be reincarnated into a good state immediately, thanks to turning evil thoughts into good thoughts. That's why the ancient saints often organized to set up Dharma repentance altars to pray for the positive and the negative, on the shore and in the water...

But having someone pray for you is still not as good as cultivating yourself! The sutra also explains that if you ask someone to pray or create merit for you, the person who practices will enjoy six parts of the merit, while the person who is dedicating merit will only enjoy one part, and the sutras always remind: Each person should cultivate themselves to fully enjoy the results of their efforts.

"Ksitigarbha Sutra" is confirmed to be a sutra that eliminates sins and eliminates karma, increases merit very quickly, thanks to the power of the great vows of Mr. Ksitigarbha, but there have been people with incurable diseases who, worried about releasing lives, doing good deeds, recited up to 108 sets but still had no results. When they asked, Guo Qing (Quả Khanh) explained: “Because people recite it, they still eat salty food. Therefore, people who eat salty chanting will not be spiritual! You must observe the five elements, fast, maintain the precepts, keep your body, speech, and mind pure and concentrate your mind single-mindedly when chanting, you will see the effect very quickly.” This matter is left to the readers to seriously verify for themselves.

SUICIDE GOS TO THE TOP

I am a lay vegetarian and follow Buddha's five precepts. I really admire the prayer: "Hell is not empty, I swear I have not yet become a Buddha!"by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. In the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" the first chapter tells that the Saint, after reciting Buddha's name for a day and night, immediately found herself in hell, knowing where her mother was born...

I really like and feel comforted when I read the scripture:

“If a person can for twenty-one days single-mindedly worship the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and recite his name ten thousand times, then Bodhisattva will appear infinitely, telling that person the world in which their relatives have been born. Or in a dream, Bodhisattva, with modern divine power, personally leads that person to the worlds to meet his relatives."

Every time I watch the news and see reports of people committing suicide, I feel extremely sad. So I really want to know where people who commit suicide will go after they die?

In Ksitigarbha Sutra, chapter 12, it is written:

"Those who hear the name and see the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and then wholeheartedly take refuge can recite Bodhisattva's name thousands of times a day, for up to a thousand days, then the wishes of those good men and good women will soon be fulfilled, forever unobstructed."

Therefore, I did a lot, more than what was taught in the sutras, that is, chanting long-term, cultivating every thought and fervently worshiping Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for a long time, praying for only one thing: “Please let me open up wisdom, be able to see and understand clearly, and know clearly where a person who commits suicide will go?”

Finally, this wish came true. In the dream, I actually went to the realm where suicidal people reside, and was clear about all matters. (In the Buddha Sutra, there are six realms: God, Human, Asura, Hell, Hungry Ghosts, Animals. So when I describe the Demon Realm, I hope you are not surprised) there are a few people who see it directly but the majority of people do not see it. (However, people who are close to death and have weak mental health can easily see people in the afterlife).

Now I invite my Dharma friends to watch and share this valuable experience with me:

“The underworld is very cold, so when contacting or visiting the underworld, it is necessary to have strong concentration, great vows, and a clear spirit. The Demon Realm is also vast and boundless, divided into many areas. Don't think that suicide is the end of suffering, but it is the beginning of endless suffering. Whether because of love, because of debt, for all kinds of reasons, etc. that you want to jump from a building, jump into a river, drink poison, cut your blood vessels, slit your throat, hang yourself, etc. suicidal thoughts... all kinds of ways... But whenever it is suicide, the sufferings one must endure after death are even more miserable. People who commit suicide and die are immediately imprisoned and immersed in constant misery.

You must know that suicide has three serious crimes:

Disrespectful to parents.

Destroying one's own body, betraying the rare blessing of being human, not knowing how to value life.

Stupid and mindless.

My body is born from my parents, and in my life I have not been filial and grateful to my parents, have not done useful things to benefit others, and have been foolish enough to self-destruct and kill myself. This is an extremely serious crime. You must know that the human body is difficult to obtain, Buddha's teachings are difficult to hear. In this life, if you have a human body, why would you despise destruction? Because your father left his human body, it will be very difficult for you to regain your human body. Committing suicide is so stupid.

For example, if you choose to commit suicide because you are in debt, you must understand that if your debt is not paid in this life, you will still have to pay more later, and now you will also have to bear the great sin of suicide. This is called suffering on top of suffering! We must know that when a person commits suicide and dies, he will receive a very miserable punishment. People who commit suicide after death will constantly repeat the act of committing suicide.

For example, Mr. A jumped from a building at 2:00 p.m. to commit suicide. After his death, his spirit consciousness will be imprisoned and suffer, and he will continue to wander around the area where he commits suicide. Every day, whenever he arrived at the exact moment he committed suicide, he would return to the exact location, that building... but performed a suicide scene once. Every day, you have to act like that, repeating that body-destructive action until your lifespan runs out. For example, your life expectancy is to live to 70, but at the age of 40 you commit suicide, then after you die, you have to re-enact this suicide scene every day, which means you have to... Jumped off the building for 30 years, until his life ended.

Moreover, every day, the extremely painful thoughts of the moment of suicide, combined with the pain in the body, also reappeared at the same time, exactly like him. That means every day, he has to recreate and experience the tragedy of suicide once. Outside of this time, he is locked up in the "Suicide Prisoner" area to serve his punishment. This area where "suicide dead" reside is very gloomy, very damp and smelly. In here, everyone's hearts are filled with resentment, cries of sadness, constant lamenting... This place has no house or bed, no television, no banquets, no food, etc. Everything is okay! There is only pain and crying.

I walked into a prison cell, inside was full of suicides, resentment filled the sky, very uncomfortable, everyone's faces were very sad to look at. I walked closer to a suicide victim and saw that his whole body was wet and his eyes were sunken. I greet:

– Are you okay?

He tilted his head to look at me, then asked:

– Who are you?

- I am a normal person, making vows to the underworld to know what will happen to those who commit suicide and die?

He said:

– No need to ask, just looking at it is enough to know that I'm in so much pain! I don't know how to describe my current feelings, I can only say that I... WOOT! SORRY!… that's it!

– Why is your whole body wet?

– Because I jumped into the river and committed suicide…

– But why did you commit suicide?

– I don't want to tell, please stop asking!

- Alright! Hello!

I walked to another place. Seeing a woman in front of him, he asked:

- Hey, why are you in this place?

She replied:

– Can you help me find a baby? I beg you.

I asked:

– Your child?

- That's right. I let my daughter commit suicide with me, but now I don't know where she is? Because after I committed suicide, I was immediately escorted here, and my child could not be found. I'm so miserable…

– Your daughter is currently in another area, waiting to be reincarnated. Because she arbitrarily took the child's life completely without his consent, her crime is very serious. Because her child was still young and innocent, he was not considered a suicide, so his grave was taken to another place.

– Is that so, no one told me this, I beg you, please take me to see him, okay?

I can't take you there, because this is the underworld and has its own rules. You must definitely suffer the retribution of suicide here, that's the law!

She burst into tears bitterly….

I continued on for a while, crossed a mountain, and came to another place. In here is a solitary confinement area for other suicides. I met a man with a long, deep gash on his stomach, covered in blood... I asked:

– Sir, what's wrong with your stomach?

He replied:

– This is the wound I used to cut my stomach with a knife because my wife had an affair with a guy... So I really hate "her"!

– Even so, you shouldn't kill yourself!

– At first I killed her, then I killed myself! If I die, I'll be locked up here. Every day I have to go back home and re-enact the suicide scene. I'm in so much pain and suffering, I'm miserable beyond words...

I complain:

– Oh! Again for love! Sir, suicide is a very serious sin. Do you swear to recite Buddha's name?

Then I taught him to recite: “Namo Ksitigarbha King Bodhisattva!” and said:

- You must recite it, it will reduce the punishment! Furthermore, he must repentance, because murder is too wrong, because he killed someone and also committed suicide, the crime is even worse! Please listen to my advice, you must definitely try to recite Buddha's name!

I just saw him nodding, not saying anything.

Before my eyes, there appeared ghosts filled with terrifying hatred. Some ghosts were covered in blood all over their bodies, flowing continuously. Having witnessed these scenes with my own eyes, I was extremely frightened.

Most people in the world think that suicide is the end of all suffering. They do not know that "suicide is the beginning of unimaginable suffering." It's so stupid and foolish! No wonder we often hear about places where people have committed suicide and there are "riots" even though we don't see them.

Because if a house, a certain room... In the past, someone committed suicide, and the ghost who committed suicide had to come back every day to re-enact this act of suicide, so it would be strange if there were no "ghosts" in that room! That's why we often hear that "where people commit suicide, there is often the sound of crying and moaning... even though I didn't see anyone. That's because the person who committed suicide had to go back and act out the suicide scene, immersed in the sadness of the moment he destroyed his body...

As for me, although I rely on the power of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva King to witness the afterlife, to be honest, if I had to stay in a house or room where someone committed suicide, I would certainly be very miserable, why? Because every day, my eyes always clearly see the ghosts coming back to reenact their suicides, and also clearly see the tragedy of how they died. So how can we be peaceful and relaxed? Buddha's teachings have very good and wonderful deliverance scriptures. But you cannot rely on someone to pray for you when you yourself do not practice. If your mind is still full of malice and evil... there is no way to save. Because the scene will correspond to the mind, a good mind attracts a good scene! deliverance is to help you develop a kind heart and know how to repent and correct your mistakes. You need to improve yourself while living, don't rely on others, that's the best.

In human life, who lives without worries or suffering? The person who keeps his body, speech, and mind good will have a happy mind. Suffering is caused by the fact that we once sowed evil. When we have to pay back evil consequences and make up for old debts, who can feel comfortable? Thousands of times I ask you not to start thinking about suicide. Must understand: Suicide doesn't solve the problem, death is even more painful! If you think living in the world is miserable, but you don't know that people who die by suicide will be locked up in the suicide ward. Stupid people think that death is the end, that all sorrows are wiped away, all worries end... Completely unaware that after committing suicide, the pain begins to come, ten thousand times more intense than the suffering while alive. Also, why don't you feel sorry for your loved ones, how sad they will be at this foolish behavior of yours? You should not take yourself to the extreme.

A person who commits suicide, after dying and receiving the retribution for committing suicide, must go to the large and small hells to receive further punishment, just as described in the Ksitigarbha Sutra... Only when karma is exhausted can they escape and be reincarnated, but where they are born depends on their karma.

noi_dung:
Buddhists Thieu Hoa

LND:I thought about it a lot, and finally decided to translate this article, hoping to warn people who want to commit suicide.

In life, no matter how miserable or desperate you are, please never want to commit suicide. Because the present suffering is unbearable, the suffering after death is even more severe! Please remember: Suicide is not the end of suffering, but the beginning of endless suffering... Because living in this life, everyone has suffering, not just you, there are even more terrible sufferings, but some people still do not run away but accept to face it, courageously step through it to grow and develop... (because the abyss is a ladder for talented people). Even though our body is dead, our mind is still active... Killing ourselves is also the crime of killing: Committing the ten heinous crimes cannot be reincarnated. When the body dies, it feels cold, hot, hungry, thirsty, depressed... still carrying it around, constantly tormenting my mind. If your mind has many evil thoughts, you will die and go downhill... If your mind is full of love and goodness, then death will rise to a higher level. Just like when you have just given, released life or done a good deed for someone, you will sleep very well at night, your mind will be filled with happiness... That is the realm of a good mind. Therefore, robbers and murderers, those who do evil deeds, will certainly never sleep peacefully and always have nightmares, even though the law has not yet punished them...

When you start wanting to commit suicide, don't let this thought continue (don't hold on to useless sadness forever because it will incite you to act foolishly), try to steer your mind to good, pure thoughts. In fact, there is no absolute road or dead end, it's just what your mind thinks it is. "If you sow sweet seeds, you will reap sweet fruits." Therefore, the way out is in your own mind, not in people or external circumstances. Make your own way out and don't get stuck in a deadlock. Suffering and happiness are created by ourselves, if we want to be happy, we must stop evil and practice good deeds - always maintain good body, speech, and mind, because the more good your mind is, the more happiness you will enjoy. Here, there is no argument to confront, if you want to know right from wrong, you can only practice, experience, and draw the answer for yourself.

LONG HO BAR

After finishing high school karma, with someone's introduction, I worked as a waiter at a restaurant called "Long Ho Pub". This pub is a place in a dense, wooded area with many wild animals. The shop's owner, surnamed Vi, is considered the king of business because he is cunning and skillful in calculating investments. Thanks to that, he makes a lot of money. He puts up a sign selling wild animal meat and offers it with the seductive words "rural specialties", and customers come in droves.

The shop is expanding and growing in scale. Mr. Vi's shop became even more crazy, everyone knew it from near and far. The restaurant has a special dish called "Dragon Tiger Fight", consisting of giant python meat cooked with wild cats, and soon this nickname became the name of the restaurant.

That way, wild cats and pythons all over the surrounding area are in trouble. Because Boss Vi always charged higher prices than other people, many money-hungry villagers were willing to risk their lives and go into danger, going into deserted mountains to find supplies for the boss. The yard behind the shop smells of blood every day, and the pitiful screams constantly echo in my ears.

One day, Mr. Vi bought a giant python six meters long, about an inch and a half fat, with iridescent scales of golden color mixed with a bit of silver. It is said that many people have lost their lives trying to catch this python. Looking at its massive physique, one can guess that it is the king of pythons.

The python lay unconscious for a day before waking up. Old Vi approached the iron cage and said:

– Ha! It looks like you're at your peak, so I won't kill you for now, but will keep you alive for a few more days.

The python seemed to understand, it raised its head high, suddenly opened its mouth wide and spat out a thick stream of foul-smelling saliva in the boss's face. Because the old man did not have time to take precautions, he could only scream loudly, then turned and ran away. We heard him roar and quickly ran over to wash his face with clean water. Python saliva is highly corrosive and destructive. If not treated promptly, it will definitely leave scars and sores.

Old Vi got angry, immediately picked up the pot of hot water and poured it into the python's cage. After venting his anger, he said fiercely:

– If it weren't for wasting money on high-priced eyelashes, this man would have chopped them up to vent his anger! Huh! Now I'll let you live better than death, then kill you in half a month and soak you in wine to celebrate your 40th birthday!

From that day onwards, the python was locked alone in a large cage in the corner of the garden, not allowed to eat or drink. He sometimes mistreated and cursed it loudly, every day had its fellow animals slaughtered, and even skinned and butchered the animals right in front of it to show off its power.

Seven or eight days passed, and the great python still did not surrender. Whenever it saw the old master, it would raise its eyes in anger and open its mouth to show its fangs. Every time we approach its cage, everyone feels terribly uneasy.

A few more days passed, and suddenly something happened: The great python in the cage flew without wings, with no trace or trace... As soon as the old owner heard this news, his face turned pale, his eyes rolled back, he went to the cage to stare and observe... Seeing that the cage was still intact without any damage, there were no gaps around. The old man guessed: “Unless someone intentionally released it? Otherwise, this giant python will definitely not be able to escape"...

The old man angrily turned away and said viciously:

– AI? WHO RELEASED IT? It's okay if you honestly confess, but if you let me investigate, you'll be flayed alive... cho coi!

We were all scared and trembling, gathered together and swore that we hadn't done that. The old owner looked sad, he turned back to the iron cage and continued observing, finally discovering the place where the great python escaped: There are two iron bars with relatively large gaps, it seems that the python escaped this way.

We talked all day, and finally had to admit the reality before us: It is true that this python's body has extremely high elasticity and is too good at wriggling; Even though the gap is so small, you can still get out. Because it wants freedom, it can endure all unimaginable suffering...

After the old man "vented his anger" - finished venting his anger - he seemed to have calmed down and no longer said anything. Around two o'clock in the morning, we were all sleeping soundly when we were awakened by horrifying screams. I jumped up in surprise and ran into the yard to observe the situation.

As soon as I saw the scene, I lost my mind. Under the bright moonlight, I saw dozens of pythons crawling all over the yard, some slithering in from outside the window. I have never witnessed a group of pythons acting like this before. Normally, the pythons in the shop all look stupid, but right now in front of my eyes, these giant pythons look very wise and are burning with anger, inconsolable rage, extremely fierce aura...

I quickly shouted the alarm everywhere:

– Wake up, wake up and run, the pythons are crawling into that house!

My terrifying echo caused an uproar in the entire area. In the blink of an eye, several snakes had crawled around, many of them had slithered to surround the old master's room, until there were no gaps left.

In the shop, the chefs and fire fighters were good at their jobs, because they had killed countless pythons. Because they were familiar with the job, they weren't very fearful. Even if they were a little scared, they quickly grabbed their tools to catch the pythons to kill. After a fierce fight, several people left the house and ran to the yard. The pythons still leisurely attacked, a few of them rushed straight to the old master's room, as if coming as reinforcements.

It seems that the main point the python wants to attack is the old master's room. Because the window was open, a few children came inside. I easily recognized the python king that had escaped from prison, because its body was golden in color and it was the largest in the herd, so it was easy to spot. At the same time, I immediately understood: It is it that guides and controls this group of snakes to take revenge!

Strangely, I didn't see the owner's figure at all, nor did I hear the sound of fighting or fighting...

I called out loudly, reminding the people still standing in the yard:

– Hurry upstairs, it's safer there!

They suddenly came to their senses, quickly rushed up the stairs, each running for their lives, rushing into the room like a whirlwind. The pythons were starting to crawl up. We joined forces, relying on the "high and low" stance, and finally repelled them.

When the group of snakes retreated from the master's room, the huge golden king snake proudly led the way, then they quickly disappeared into the dense forest behind the mountain.

When we were sure the danger had passed, we went downstairs. Seeing that the two disciples, Nhan Trung Vi and Ly Truong Huu, had not left the room yet. These two people usually specialize in killing snakes, they have killed countless pythons. We were horrified to the point of gasping when we discovered that both men's bones and tendons were severed, their internal organs were torn open, their organs were bleeding, and they had long since died.

As for the windows of the female service group's room, because they were closed, the python could not enter. Thanks to that, no one of them was injured, just a "terrifying" scare.

So where is shop owner Vi? We wondered and approached his room door. Outside was a mess, and there was no sign of him. We were nervous, tried to go inside, and saw even more chaos, the place was full of traces of pythons trampling. Moreover, it still has a strong fishy smell.

Strangely, old Vi was still nowhere to be seen. “Could it be that he was kidnapped by the python or swallowed by it? It's scary”… Thinking about this, my head feels numb, my spine feels cold, and I get goosebumps all over my body...

At this time, without an appointment, we all noticed a large jar in the corner of the wall, this jar is about 1m5 high, the lid is made of wood and has a handle, but now the jar has an upside-down lid, meaning the handle is turned inward, the jar's wall is covered with traces of snakes swinging and hanging... Surely old Vi is in there?

We call it small:

– Boss, the python has retreated, please leave quickly!

We kept calling but didn't hear anything. We had a bad feeling, so we approached and trembled and took cover. Seeing Mr. Vi's entire body cowering, his face pale, his eyes rolling and his tongue sticking out, his ten fingers clutching tightly on the lid of the jar until it bled, he died so miserably that he couldn't bear to look.

Perhaps as soon as Old Vi saw the pythons coming in, he knew he couldn't get out, so he crawled into the jar and pulled the lid shut. The king snake hates him to the core, how can he easily let go? It held extreme anger and combined with the group of pythons surrounding the jar, attacking with all their might... The snakes pressed the lid of the jar tightly, not allowing any air to get in, causing Mr. Vi to suffocate inside.

This unprecedented and terrible story quickly spread throughout the region and throughout the villages... As for the people in this locality, no one dares to kill snakes anymore.

Bao Quang

STORIES OF SCIENTISTS

The author of this article is layperson Tu Quang, and his family are both prominent scientists. His parents are two scientists, working together at the Chinese Academy of Sciences. After the author researched Buddhism, he was impressed and took refuge in the Three Noble Truths. It was his filial piety and sincere application of Buddha's teachings that saved his mother right when she had one foot in the demon gate. Thanks to that, his parents regained their minds and embarked on the path of studying and following Buddha. This story is completely true and very believable. We invite you to read his autobiography:

In February 1989, I took refuge in Buddha at Ngoa Long Pagoda in Xi'an with Master Tri Chan. In 1991, I took office and taught at a certain graduate school in Beijing. For more than 20 years, I have specialized in teaching and training people, both scientific research and spiritual practice. Although I have not been diligent enough, I have enjoyed many profound benefits in both living and work.

In the past, I only heard stories about learning about Buddha's boundless effects from Dharma travelers. But later I experienced it myself. This true story happened right at my house, strange and magical beyond measure. Because I want to repay all Buddhas and Bodhisattva, I am reporting this matter, hoping that Buddhists will grow in true and steadfast faith.

In early 2008, my mother had serious heart disease and high blood pressure. In less than half a year, her heart beat so fast and suddenly stopped four times that she fell into a coma and fainted.

One time, my father went to the market to buy things. After leaving my mother for about half an hour, when he returned, he saw her lying on the ground, her head bleeding... Then, even though she was awake, she didn't have the strength to get up. When I took my mother to major hospitals for treatment, my mother no longer had the strength to go. The doctor examined her and found that my mother's heart was beating fast, she was often nervous, panicked, and her pulse was irregular and skipped a beat.

The doctor said: Surgery for an 85-year-old elderly person will be very dangerous. If you are not exhausted to the end, try not to have surgery, so you can only use medicine to ease your condition.

By 2009, my mother was sick every day or two and could hardly sleep all night. The doctor gave me medicine for my heart and high blood pressure, but it was all ineffective. So I was sad when I saw my mother's ineffective treatment. When the weather changes, her illness gets worse. Even when the new meteorological station predicted cold air had just arrived in Xinjiang, my mother already felt uncomfortable. Her body was in extreme decline. At night, her heart often stops beating or jumps wildly, causing her to feel nervous and anxious...

On the last Saturday of May 2009, I went to Trung Quan village to visit my parents. My father said:

– The summer air is hot and hot like this, I'm afraid your mother won't survive.

Unable to sit there and watch my mother wait to die, in the moment of danger I thought of Buddha's teachings, and wanted to secretly create merit for my mother. At that time, I knew the "Vajra Sutra". I knew that the merits of the "Vajrayana Sutra" were unimaginably wonderful, so I decided to chant the "Vajra Sutra" sutras dedicating the merit merits for her, praying to all Buddhas Bodhisattva to bless my mother's illness.

So on Sunday I started chanting. Every day at 5:00 a.m. I wake up and recite a set of "Diamond Sutras". After chanting, I dedicating merit and two vows:

1.First, pray for the mother's unjust bondholder family. (Having studied Buddhism for more than 20 years, I know that diseases that cannot be cured all belong to karma, and are definitely caused by unjust bondholders coming to collect debts and harassing them... Therefore, it is very necessary to dedicating merit to these unjust bondholders that cannot be seen with the human eye). The content of dedicating merit is roughly as follows:

“I would like to dedicate the merit of reciting this 'Vajra Sutra' to all my mother's bondholders. Please stop torturing and tormenting my mother. I know you are suffering, my mother is also suffering. But continuing to harass like this will cause both sides (both defeat and injury) to suffer losses. Now I chant the Vajra Sutras, dedicating merit and virtue to you, praying that you can eliminate karma obstacles, be able to leave suffering and attain happiness, and be born in a good realm, hope that you will develop the mind to take refuge in the Three Jewels, believe and pray to recite the Buddha, rebirth the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss World.

2.Then I gave instructions to my mother as follows:

"May mother and child's karma be eliminated, blessings will increase, longevity will be healthy, develop faith and pray to recite the Buddha's name, after completing this body, rebirth the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss World."

I recited for a week, completing seven sets of the "Vajra Sutra". Because when I chanted at around 5 am, I was afraid of affecting my loved ones' sleep, so I only chanted silently. When I recited the Dedicating Merit, I also chanted silently, each change was clear in my mind, I just couldn't read it out loud. But about reciting the "Vajra Sutra" dedicating merit to my mother, I never said a word to my mother or anyone else.

After a week, I went to Trung Quan to visit my parents. When I asked about my mother's illness, my father looked excited and said:

– Fortunately, this week your mother's heart and blood pressure have been fine, so she sleeps very well every day. 7 consecutive days without getting sick, this is something that has never happened in nearly a year.

Hearing that, I was excited, secretly guessing that my chanting sutras for my mother had an effect... So I told everyone the story, everyone who heard it was surprised, everyone thought it was unimaginably wonderful!

Only then did my mother reveal the story she had kept hidden for so long, and I was even more shocked when I heard it. My mother confided that before, she was afraid that if she told her, no one would believe her, so she had to stay silent.

For nearly a year now, every night she has had high blood pressure, extremely tired heart, can't sleep, and also always sees people walking back and forth in the house. My mother emphasized that she was not dreaming, she was still completely awake, yet she always saw those people! I was a bit panicked and immediately asked:

– How are they?

Mother replied:

– They have enough men and women, relatively old age...

– So what does it look like?

– Most mothers can't see your face clearly. Not only that, in the middle of the night, my mother also heard the sound of women crying. One time, a big, strong man with a ferocious appearance jumped at me and grabbed my arm. Mom grabbed me and escaped...

Mother explains:

– Because I'm afraid of seeing this group of people, every night when I sleep, my mother doesn't dare to turn her face outside. But even though I was lying against the wall, one time, less than 30cm in front of my mother, suddenly appeared an old, ugly, extremely dirty and smelly person... So much so that my mother had to vomit, vomit repeatedly, and then that strange person disappeared.

Before 1949, my mother had good university karma. Before she retired, she was an employee of the "Chinese Institute of Advanced Scientific Research", she worked in Zhongguan Village. Because she was a high-level intellectual and had worked for decades at the Academy of Sciences, she had never come into contact with what was classified as superstition? Of course, it is impossible to accept phenomena (including people and animals) in this field, she never believes in ghosts and gods! But this time, how unfortunate! She personally met the ghost while she was still alive, and it was not a hallucination that made her believe it, even if she didn't want to!

I asked:

– Why didn't you tell me sooner? Mom, don't you understand how dangerous and scary this is? The scary thing is, at that time, my mother had already stepped into the ghost gate!

I explained to my mother clearly:

– Among the six paths, the Human Path, the Animal Path and the Devil Path... All three of these realms live in one space. We can see the animal realm, but the demon realm is negative, so normal humans, thanks to their more positive yang energy, the demon realm beings have no way to approach, so we don't see them.

However, the unjust bondholders who have passed away and are currently suffering in the Devil's Path are always waiting, waiting for people to become seriously ill or about to die, when their yin energy is strong and their yang energy is weak, then they immediately approach to collect debts, torture, and take revenge... Therefore, the moment I see the beings of the Demon realm, I have already stepped into the Demon gate. If I would tell you everything early, I could do Buddha's work to rescue you sooner...

Mom said:

– But for about a week now, my mother hasn't seen the ghosts anymore (starting from the day I chanted sutras dedicating merit merit for my mother and her unjust bondholder family, the ghosts disappeared that night and didn't come to bother me all week).

For the next half a year, I continuously recited the "Vajra Sutra" dedicating merit to my parents, reciting about 100 sets. From summer Sunday 2009 onwards, my mother's heart disease and high blood pressure improved. By taking medicine once a day, the amount of medicine was also reduced by half, less than usual.

My parents belong to the intellectual community, they graduated from karma university before 1949, they are both excellent scientists, work at the Institute of Advanced Sciences, so convincing them to believe in Buddha was very difficult.

I have studied Buddhism for more than twenty years. On the one hand, I preached Buddha's teachings for my parents to understand, but my father was still half-believing and half-skeptical, and my mother definitely did not believe.

But from the moment I recited the "Vajrayana Sutra" to pray for my mother, I received a wonderful response. This event shocked and impressed my two stubborn scientists. This time, the two of them were completely convinced and began to believe in Buddha's teachings and develop Buddha's thoughts to seek birth in the West.

My mother is 88 years old. Every day, every morning and evening, she spends an hour walking, reciting Buddha as she walks. She is in good spirits and health. Compared to half a year ago, she is like two different people.

The father is also 88 years old, every day he meditates and recites Buddha's name for more than two hours. I also bought a Buddha recitation machine and kept it on for 24 hours to help my parents strengthen their concentration.

My story of induction, if judged scientifically, still meets the conditions to prove:

Obviously, during the week I was chanting the "Vajra Sutra" for my mother, I never revealed this to my parents or anyone else, and even during the chanting sutras I was completely unaware of my mother's mystery. Therefore, when everything is resolved smoothly, it cannot be concluded that it was all caused by my "self-suggestion" or "hallucination". Therefore, I am completely convinced that the merit of the "Vajrayana Sutra" is truly unimaginably miraculous!
